Peter \-- Hundreds and hundreds of thousands of dollars were spent to CRUSH liberty in Minnesota. From Roseau to Albert Lea, the Swamp was pulling out all the stops.
## But the Swamp lost - BIG TIME!
The results are in... Last night was a HUGE night for the Liberty Movement in Minnesota. The Republican Establishment brought out the big guns in the last couple of weeks to try to STOP grassroots, conservative candidates. **I asked you to vote in yesterday's primary and it looks like it made a BIG difference.** First and foremost, the top legislator we have in St Paul won last night. Rep Erik Mortensen had the whole swamp working against him, including a [state rep who drove 160 miles to door knock his wife](https://www.action4liberty.com/legislator_door_knocks_wife_of_rep_mortensen?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=last_night_s_results&n=2) and try to get her to vote for Mort's opponent. Can't make this stuff up! Do you remember the Lobbyist Legislator named Kurt Daudt? He's the one that did a [paid commercial telling you to get your vaccine](https://www.action4liberty.com/lobbyist_legislator_daudt_featured_in_get_your_vaccine_commercial?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=last_night_s_results&n=3) and said on the House floor that masks protect us. A political committee aligned with him spent tens of thousands of dollars to defeat Mort and other liberty candidates in Minnesota.

Speaking of lies, that same political committee spent big money against **Health Freedom Champion Mark Bishofsky of Stillwater**. They even accused him of being for vaccine mandates despite the fact Mark was the organizer of the massive health freedom rallies at the Capitol. Luckily, the primary voters in that district didn't fall for the lies. Mark Bishofsky won by 20 points! That's a big statement. Mark is a solid man and a great, conservative leader. #
We're calling on Greg Abbott to formally accept Beto's invitation to three town hall-style debates this fall. **[If you agree that Abbott must answer directly to Texans for his indefensible record, will you chip in $3 now to show that Beto has a grassroots movement behind him calling for these important debates?](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220810-2.99pCcH&refcode=ema20220810-202528&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=202528%2E444211%2EAD1Hf4)**
Here’s how we got to this moment:
**FIRST:** Abbott's team said the governor would NOT debate Beto unless "it's a competitive race."
**THEN:** Abbott's lead plummeted by 10 points since Beto joined the race — causing _The New York Times_ to call it "the most competitive since Democrats last held that office in the 1990s."
**NOW:** Abbott knows that Beto has the momentum so he's trying to hide from being held accountable by Texans — and Beto — by only agreeing to ONE debate on a Friday night.
While Beto has held 80 town hall meetings where he has answered over 500 questions, Abbott has not held public town halls where he takes questions in person during the general election. One debate in one community (on a Friday night!) for the entire state of Texas is not nearly enough. **The people of Texas deserve better.**

In case you missed it, last week Jocelyn delivered an important testimony to the U.S. Senate Judiciary Committee on the increasingly violent threats facing election workers.
Jocelyn and her fellow election officials across the country should not have to face harassment from extremists for simply doing their non-partisan work of delivering safe and secure elections.
Add your name today if you agree with Jocelyn that the U.S. Congress must act now to protect our country’s election workers from violent extremists. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/pTuYLvyKh0Gl0HpXpEiZuw2]
-Team Benson HQ
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Team Benson
Date: Monday, August 8, 2022 at 6:46 PM
Subject: Jocelyn’s testimony on election violence
To: Our friend
Friend,
Jocelyn delivered testimony to the Senate Judiciary Committee about the wave of threats facing election workers across the country, and how despite this unprecedented era of harassment against our election officials, state legislatures are failing to protect them.
“We cannot have a secure democracy if we do not protect the security of the people who administer our elections.”Watch Jocelyn’s important testimony below, and add your name to our petition demanding that Congress passes legislation protecting election workers. >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=080422]
secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=080422 [secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=080422]Jocelyn has experienced violent threats and harassment firsthand, and according to recent surveys, a majority of her colleagues continue to face those threats on a regular basis as well.
Our heroic election officials are on the frontlines of democracy to ensure that our elections remain safe, secure, and transparent for all voters. Watch Jocelyn’s testimony and add your name to our petition supporting her demand that more be done to protect election workers. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=080422]
-Team Benson

The counties comprising the Rio Gr | [](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=cabb487a6219451ba4795a0a82d6bee0&_e=RolPDx_7-XD7u_5duBJ993eUCjq_ipKFnXoh-WpttQNeA_Ib4KDVmOK6OvnKnQ0mf2O96c08XuzMUdAPGYiwRpCz6AERhS9bu6b3sTEqW9r6ki7MPP2-NSOJGxVFwiqSbYOmB09tE-ed_LqCxFVYfDZks51xKQy7ZCp_jvoDPPC1scPN9jdW8wG_UWfDqVJ9yTgSfmHKdMiUAh-rI_EcgAj-hXL83lAzVhMPbPh17VZeNemrYxhJx2-XXx4wHMHUuexorKWZxAUeBhGQJp7YskquADKfyeJu-0tWeMMaFL7j4VWtxkMKampYtDhIa0PHwm9G7vGlKTSANloVtBuyvycXjyu27aX6LyPaPlzIo3e-RcFtckeElRgbaq2w0MLpwPB6YQ8-JaNkJoVVJ_pVfj-stvvA5YN-BBXXz2waJG7VCoJGchxOy19Oh-P8fPrb3s4x1r_qdl_mM7-OA-mcC8GezHPHMZpLMG51hCYBbhrLlYc1CNYZBjl3NRqeedkB)
---
Fellow patriot,

If you take a moment to listen to the mainstream media talking heads or read opinion pieces in left-leaning newspapers, there is a good chance that if they reference Texas in a story it’s likely they’re trying to get the reader to buy into the narrative that Texas is on the cusp of flipping Democrat in the near future and that Republicans are doing everything in their power to stop the inevitable.

**But that couldn’t be further from the truth.**

As you may know, 2022 marks the second election in a row that I’m running to represent Texas 15th Congressional District in the U.S. House– **which since 1903 has only ever elected Democrats as federal representatives in Washington. **

Here are five reasons you need to pay attention to my congressional race deep in the heart of South Texas:
1. **In 2020, I ran against a Democrat incumbent no one thought I could beat; while I came up short, I only missed the mark by 6,588 votes – or 2.8%**
2. South Texas shifted more dramatically toward Trump than any other region in the United States in the 2020 election. The counties comprising the Rio Grande Valley are home to communities that are almost entirely Hispanic.
3. **Despite what national Democrats want people to believe, Hispanics in South Texas support border security, despite being labeled as “self-hating” by angry leftists.**
4. Democrats look at Hispanics through a single lens, whether they’re trying to court Mexicans in Los Angeles or Puerto Ricans in New York. South Texas is neither.
5. **Tejanos (as we call ourselves in South Texas) are culturally conservative; There is nothing conservative about today’s Democrat Party.**

Now, he's back at it again, saying this about me on MSNBC earlier this week:

He worked his way out of poverty, put himself through law school at Yale, and fought to advance his career. This man is driven by his faith, family, and love for freedom and his country.

But that's not enough anymore.

Justice Thomas went against the "acceptable" BLM and Media narrative.

name: Brandon Tatum, BLEXIT
subject: Justice Clarence Thomas is a role model for Black men and women
body:
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60976545:JV97crVNW:m:1:3317145305:F5562A9EB0D2683FD41A15B68F7CC14D:r)

Peter,

Justice Clarence Thomas is the number one man to hate online.

Not because he voted to overturn Roe V. Wade... Not because he's a believer in the Constitution... _The real reason is that he 's a **Black man** who is NOT a victim, loves America, and refuses the media's narrative_.

The media, Black Lives Matter (BLM), and victimhood culture have launched an outright racist attack against this heroic man.

Some radicals (and even celebrities like Samuel L. Jackson) are calling him an _ "Uncle Tom"_ or _ "House n--" _(I won't dignify these people by writing their full comments).

The media and BLM are revealing their hand on how they wish to keep Black people under their thumb and in line with their narrative.

**They will attack any successful Black person who falls out of lockstep with them, as they showed with Justice Thomas.**

My name is Brandon Tatum, and I co-founded BLEXIT with Candace Owens. BLEXIT is extending an opportunity for you to get involved and help empower Black communities to abolish the mainstream narrative of victimhood ideology.

[**I 've set a goal to raise $48,000 in the next 48 hours to fund our outreach and empower young men and women who have dreams like Justice Thomas. Can you help us reach this goal with a donation of $10, $35, $50, or any amount? Click here to send your gift >>>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60976545:JV97crVNW:m:1:3317145305:F5562A9EB0D2683FD41A15B68F7CC14D:r)

The media, BLM, and their allies need to keep Black communities enslaved intellectually - we cannot deviate and be our own individuals.

It's the only way they can retain the power they've stolen from us.

BLEXIT is founded on the belief that Black communities must end the victimhood mentality that the media and BLM force on us.

When I co-founded BLEXIT, I vowed above all else that we were NOT just a "think tank", but a thoughtful and quick-acting "DO-tank." We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing and going places that are often ignored, like Detroit and Baltimore.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:
1. Advocating for School Choice.
2. Promoting a pro-police criminal justice reform.
3. Championing entrepreneurship and free enterprise.
4. Developing history programs that will inspire minority children.
5. Presenting the message of BLEXIT through art and live experiences.

All while championing our values of _**faith, family, and freedom**_ to empower Black and urban communities.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60976545:JV97crVNW:m:1:3317145305:F5562A9EB0D2683FD41A15B68F7CC14D:r)

This is a deeply personal topic for me, Peter, because I also had to learn how not to be a victim.

_Growing up, I was often told how "helpless" I was_.

But not just me. It's the same message thousands of men, women, and children have heard for decades.

It's heartbreaking to hear, to feel that no one cares because you'll never be enough.

We were taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, that the police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is a LIE. This message is nothing but intellectual slavery.

And when I spoke out about it, I was attacked, just like Justice Thomas. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

[**That 's why I am asking you to be part of the solution and help empower minority communities. Can you chip in $25, $50, or any amount to help reach our goal of $48,000 in the next 48 hours? Click here to send your donation >>>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60976545:JV97crVNW:m:1:3317145305:F5562A9EB0D2683FD41A15B68F7CC14D:r)

_Justice Clarence Thomas is the American Dream and an example of BLEXIT 's efforts to exit the culture of victimhood and government dependence_.

He worked his way out of poverty, put himself through law school at Yale, and fought to advance his career. This man is driven by his faith, family, and love for freedom and his country.

But that's not enough anymore.

Justice Thomas went against the "acceptable" BLM and Media narrative.

BLEXIT exists to empower Black and minority communities, not stand by and watch them be attacked and slandered.

You and I are empowering thousands to realize their dreams and be successful in life.

Help BLEXIT find the next Justice Clarence Thomas.

Peter, I am personally asking you to help make this dream a reality. Can you send your urgent donation today?

[**Donate $25 >>>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60976546:JV97crVNW:m:1:3317145305:F5562A9EB0D2683FD41A15B68F7CC14D:r)

| | | Peter,

As the son of Cuban immigrants who grew up surrounded by families who fled political persecution, Joe Biden's FBI raid on President Trump's home looks all too familiar.

Once these radical dictators take power,****_**first**_ , they persecute their political opponents. _**Next**_ , they target anyone who stood with their political opponents - until they lock up everyone who disagrees with them.

**This is a gross abuse of power, and we have to stand together to fight back.[Yesterday, I said I needed 250 patriots, but as of 11:00 AM today, we still need 116 patriots to STAND UP to the Left in the next hour:](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60976714:6F_OcrVxN:m:1:3253819041:A5A2B591F646875A379AA731767FA43D:r "Yesterday, I said

LEFT FROM ABUSING POWER")

Please, don't let America turn into the next banana republic. We need to protect our country and its integrity. We can't let Joe Biden and his FBI turn it into a state where we target anyone who disagrees with the president.

America is in **TROUBLE** because for the most part, the American Church has failed to keep _the main thing, the main thing_. I believe the Church in America is in desperate need of a spiritual revival and at [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=13793158.7702.1.ce019843daee80e825278f37492df755) we want to do our part. This Fall, we are launching [Sheridan Bible Institute](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=13793158.7703.1.3c2777f2f86c7681205c1759e361a767)! This will be a _one-year program_ designed to **educate** , **equip** and **empower** believers to bring about **real transformation** to our nation. Each semester will consist of six courses. The classes will take place on Tuesday and Thursday evenings starting at 6 pm CT. There will be three classes on Tuesday evening and three classes on Thursday evening with each class being fifty minutes. For the Fall semester, I will be teaching **Old Testament Survey** and **History of Christianity Pt.1**. The other courses will be taught by Instructors that I know have _studied to show themselves approved_. If you would like to **dive deeper into the Word of God** then I want to encourage you to checkout [Sheridan Bible Institute](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=13793158.7704.1.b214ecb573babecde8479498e3560168). Each class will be streamed live online as well as uploaded with a link for our online students. The pricing is **TOTALLY** affordable. Tuition is only $300 per semester (around $100/month). name: Office of U.S. Senator Raphael Warnock
subject: Securing Critical Resources for Georgia's Economy
body:
|
---
Hi Neighbor, I have some exciting news to share. Yesterday, the President signed into law H.R. 4346, the CHIPS and Science Act of 2022. I've spoken with and read messages from countless Georgians who have told me that creating jobs, supporting manufacturing, and boosting domestic production of semiconductors, also known as chips, are their top priorities. I always appreciate hearing from Georgians on these important issues, and I'm proud to share more about this piece of legislation and the actions I've taken to not only fight for, but also achieve, these goals for Georgia.

Semiconductors are a critical component to technology products that Georgia families use every day, from laptops and cell phones to cars and even washing machines. Unfortunately, disruptions in the global chip supply have led to shortages and rising costs for many families. As a member of the Senate Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation, which oversees technology and manufacturing policy, restoring American leadership in chip manufacturing has been a top priority for me.

That's why I was glad to join my colleagues to pass the jobs and competition bill in the U.S. Senate last month--known as H.R. 4346, the CHIPS and Science Act of 2022. I have been working to pass this bill for over a year, including representing Georgia in the bipartisan, bicameral conference committee that was charged with negotiating this legislation.

This bipartisan legislation includes many of the priorities I have championed, including $52 billion in investments and tax incentives that will boost domestic production of chips, $2 billion of which will focus exclusively on legacy chip production that will benefit automakers, which employ thousands of Georgians. The law also provides $2 billion to support small- and medium-sized domestic manufacturers with cybersecurity, workforce training, and supply chain resiliency. Additionally, it invests $81 billion over five years to support scientific research and development, of which a substantial portion will strengthen research capacity at Georgia HBCUs and other small institutions that lack the resources to compete with larger institutions for federal research dollars. This funding also includes support to help researchers move their ideas to the marketplace, creating good-paying jobs right here at home.

Lastly, the CHIPS and Science Act provides $10 billion to support the creation of regional technology hubs that will focus on technology development, job creation, and expanding America's innovation capacity. According to researchers, Georgia cities like Atlanta, Savannah, Columbus, and Macon are all strong candidates for these investments, which will create new local jobs and training opportunities for hardworking Georgians.

Now that the CHIPS and Science Act is signed into law, I look forward to working with federal agencies, state and local governments, colleges and universities, and Georgia industries to channel these historic investments to boost American semiconductor production, create good-paying jobs, unlock supply chain backlogs, and help lower costs for Georgians.

I will continue working hard to drive federal investments into the state of Georgia to expand economic opportunities and to meet the needs of Georgia families and businesses. Please do not hesitate to contact me again in the future if I may be of assistance to you or your family.

Keep the faith, and keep looking up.
U.S. Senator Reverend Raphael Warnock

| | | | | Peter, **If you haven't seen the viral video of Beto O'Rourke responding to a Greg-Abbott supporting heckler as he talked about the somber reality of our children murdered by assault rifles...you must.** **_[THANK BETO for saying what must be said, and doing what must be done. Please join us in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Beto O'Rourke. In fetid, disrespectful, and honestly abominable right-wing fashion, as he was talking about children being murdered by assault rifles, he was heckled by a Greg Abbott supporter in the crowd who started laughing.** ** **_Laughing at kids dying via assault rifle. Think about that._** **Then Beto responded the way we all wish we had, not like some polished politician but a real human with real emotions:** **_" It may be funny to you motherf***er but it's not funny to me."_**

Virginians are doing great work, and I know there are ways we can improve their lives and their livelihoods if we keep doing what we are expected to do in Washington. _[**Chip in $5 today so we can keep our majority and keep creating the kind of change people in Virginia want to see. **](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49077116/360750347/1143066613?refcode=mw_em_220810_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Manassas&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MWFhNzIyMi04NDE5LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BRBRcbUAWX_qQ2UYBlMdEBf83VD4hbwVbGGxVogSr1w=)_ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49077118/360750349/1143066613?refcode=mw_em_220810_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Manassas&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MWFhNzIyMi04NDE5LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BRBRcbUAWX_qQ2UYBlMdEBf83VD4hbwVbGGxVogSr1w=) I got to see the impact of legislation like the American Rescue Plan and the Bipartisan Infrastructure bill all over the Commonwealth. In Fredericksburg, I spoke with residents about the money the city is receiving to build a stage and public restrooms on the riverfront to boost the local economy. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49077120/360750351/1143066613?refcode=mw_em_220810_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Manassas&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MWFhNzIyMi04NDE5LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BRBRcbUAWX_qQ2UYBlMdEBf83VD4hbwVbGGxVogSr1w=) I presented a check for $15 million at the Roanoke-Blacksburg Airport that will improve the airport and increase capacity. In Fishersville, I talked with people about the money coming their way to expand bus service in the region, because public transit isn’t just important in huge cities. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49077122/360750353/1143066613?refcode=mw_em_220810_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Manassas&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MWFhNzIyMi04NDE5LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BRBRcbUAWX_qQ2UYBlMdEBf83VD4hbwVbGGxVogSr1w=) I also got to hear about the work we still need to do. My staff and I are working hard to get more federal funding for last mile internet and cell coverage to help folks I spoke with in Craig County and Highland County. And we’re discussing ways to help the forestry workers I spoke with in Bath County who are facing challenges with inflation and with logging regulations. _[**But progress on these issues, and many more, will be dealth a serious blow if Republicans take the majority in November. name: Rep. Dana Criswell
subject: Statement on FBI Raids
body:
Statement on FBI Political Targeting of President Trump and Chairman Perry FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEContact: Chairman Dana CriswellMississippi Freedom Caucus662-469-6242info@freedomcaucus.msJackson, | |
---

| | | Statement on FBI Political Targeting of President Trump and Chairman Perry |
---|---|---
| **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE****Contact** : Chairman Dana CriswellMississippi Freedom Caucus662-469-6242info@freedomcaucus.ms **Jackson, MS (August 11, 2022) -** In response to the FBI raid on President Trump's private Florida residence at Mar-a-Lago and the political targeting of U.S. House Freedom Caucus Chairman Scott Perry, the Mississippi Freedom Caucus has issued the following statement:The Mississippi Freedom Caucus is appalled by the apparent political weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the Federal Bureau of Investigations in raiding President Trump's Mar-a-Lago home and confiscating Chairman Perry's personal cellphone. As more details emerge in the coming days, we hope to find out why these unannounced actions were deemed appropriate by the directors of the DOJ and FBI and whether President Biden had any direct involvement in what appears to be a politically motivated targeting of former President Trump and the House Freedom Caucus. "First, the unannounced raid on a former US President's private residence is both unprecedented and disgraceful, and now to hear that the FBI is targeting U.S. House Freedom Caucus members is unbelievable," said Mississippi Freedom Caucus Chairman Dana Criswell. "The current administration is making a mockery of our justice system and using law enforcement for politically motivated means. The American people deserve to know the truth behind the justification of the raid and who approved such actions."With the left calling for defunding the police and the Democratic leaders using federal law enforcement as an arm for political means, the Democrats continue to create a mockery of our justice system and of law enforcement. We hope that this situation will be fully investigated by the U.S. House Oversight Committee once Republicans retake the House. These actions, along with the Democrats pushing to add nearly 90,000 additional IRS agents, should frighten any American who stands for conservative values, knowing that they too could be unjustly targeted. The Mississippi Freedom Caucus will continue to fight for Liberty and Justice, and to protect the citizens of the Great State of Mississippi._###_ |
|
* * *
| The Caucus is a political organization dedicated to promoting the ideals of individual rights, limited government and free enterprise within the state of Mississippi.

Jackson, MS 39202

info@freedomcaucus.ms

body:
Check out our team's latest updates here! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/e7a3ce38ee26/come-meet-me-at-nighthawk-pizza-brewery-tonight-9044749?e=22db41c18e)
---
Peter,I have spent the last few months talking with voters around Northern Virginia, and all of them are united in wanting change from our politicians in Washington. I am proud to be running a totally grassroots campaign to bring qualified leadership to Congress, but our work is just beginning.I’m pleased to announce that, following his endorsement of my campaign, Governor Glenn Youngkin and I will be teaming up for a Door Knocking Rally in McLean on August 20!Can you join us? The details are below!
| [GIVE $20 TO RETIRE DON BEYER IN NOVEMBER!](https://karinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5169078bc3370360935103e65&id=0370e3489e&e=22db41c18e)
---
# JOIN THE LATINOS POR KARINA TONIGHT AT 6PM!
My campaign is building momentum with members of our community from all walks of life. The diverse communities that make up our district attest to the power of the American Dream—the same dream me and my family sought after when we came from Ukraine.Join me TONIGHT for an event with the Latinos Por Karina coalition! The event is at 6pm in Arlington at Los Chamacos Mexican Restaurant, and we’ll be discussing the biggest issues impacting the Latino community in District 8.To RSVP and join the #LatinosPorKarina coalition, email [latinosporkarina@gmail.com](mailto:latinosporkarina@gmail.com) with your name and information!More information can be found below:
| [DONATE HERE TO JOIN THE MOMENTUM!](https://karinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5169078bc3370360935103e65&id=2a098a1ff5&e=22db41c18e)
---
# Upcoming Events
Here is a list of what’s going on over the next few weeks! Save your spot today and come say hello!**August 11:** Meet me at the Annandale Farmers’ Market this morning! 6621 Columbia Pike, Annandale, VA 22003 - No need to RSVP! Come and say hello!*****August 11:** Latinos for Karina Happy Hour – 6:00-7:30pm at Los Chamacos, 922 South Walter Reed Drive, Arlington, VA 22204 – email [LatinosPorKarina@gmail.com](mailto:LatinosForKarina@gmail.com) to RSVP and receive more info on how to join the momentum!**August 12:** Meet me at the McLean Farmers’ Market Friday morning at 10am! 1659 Chain Bridge Road, McLean, VA 22101 - No need to RSVP! Come and say hello!**August 12:** Meet me at the Kingstowne Farmers’ Market Friday evening at 5pm! - No need to RSVP! Come and say hello!**August 13:** Meet me at the Viva Cultura Festival on Saturday at 11am! Gateway Park, 1300 Lee Highway, Arlington, VA 22209 - No need to RSVP! Come by and enjoy the festival with Karina and her Latinos coalition!**August 13:** Join Karina at the Peruvian Cultural Heritage Night in Annandale on Saturday at 7:30pm! Ossian Hall Park, 7900 Heritage Drive, Annandale, VA 22003 - No need to RSVP! Come by and enjoy the show with Karina!*****August 20:** Join Governor Youngkin and Karina for a Door Knocking Rally in McLean at 9am! Lewinsville Park Pavilion, 1659 Chain Bridge Road, McLean, VA — Show up, pick up some Karina swag, and wear comfortable shoes!*****August 25:** First Lady of Virginia, Suzanne Youngkin to host special VIP fundraiser for Karina. Details pending. Email [RSVP@KarinaForCongress.com](mailto:RSVP@KarinaForCongress.com), subject “SY Event” for details.***
| [DONATE TODAY TO SUPPORT MY CAMPAIGN!](https://karinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5169078bc3370360935103e65&id=e20c089035&e=22db41c18e)
---
# THIS WEEK’S ENDORSEMENTS!
I am so proud to receive the endorsement of these organizations this past week. Our momentum to #RetireBeyer is building across Northern Virginia!**Disabled Veterans' PAC:** _"Karina supports our veterans, our military, and our great country so do whatever you can to support her fight," Disabled Veterans PAC Chairman and Founder Jason Gilbert said. "Volunteer, donate, and vote for Karina on Election Day."_**Maggie's List:** _“Karina is the embodiment of the American Dream, and I can think of no one better to represent Virginia’s 8th District in Congress,” said Maggie’s List Virginia Co-Chair and Spokesperson Tina Ramirez. “She espouses the Maggie’s List values of strong national security, limited government and fiscal responsibility and we are proud to support her election effort this fall.”_**RightNOW Women PAC:** _“Karina Lipsman is unapologetically proud to be an American and knows the freedoms we take for granted, others pray for around the world,” RightNOW Women PAC chair Ariel Judah said. “We are thankful that a candidate of her caliber is stepping up and giving the voters of Virginia’s 8th congressional district suffering from ‘Beyer’s remorse’ a real choice this November. She has our enthusiastic endorsement.”_**Latino National Republican Coalition of Virginia:**_“The Latino National Republican Coalition of Virginia (LNRC-VA) endorses Karina Lipsman, Republican Nominee to the U.S. House of Representatives, VA-8th, Congressional District," LNRC-VA Chairwoman Astrid Gamez said. "As an immigrant, Karina has lived the American Dream and wants to protect and preserve that dream for others. The 8th District is over 40% immigrant and/or minority. Don Beyer does not represent these voices. Karina will bring opportunity, prosperity and a better tomorrow for all in Northern Virginia.”_
Check out the upcoming events above to see how you can join the momentum!
For common sense in Northern Virginia!KarinaPS — Don’t forget to RSVP to a special VIP fundraiser with Suzanne Youngkin on August 25th by emailing [RSVP@karinaforcongress.com](mailto:RSVP@karinaforcongress.com)!

name: Sara Gideon
subject: Abortion is at stake in these four races
body:
We have a big fight ahead Folks, we have a big fight ahead of us if we want to protect access to abortion.

The Supreme Court’s unprecedented decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ has shifted the battle for safe and legal abortion to the states. **Simply put, in many states a person’s access to abortion is going to come down to who their governor is.**

subject: ProChoice Voter Endorses Vedat Gashi for Congress
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gashi for Congress |
body:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
August 11, 2022
Contact: Yuridia Peña, yuridia@altaconsulting.co, (718) 790-0837

PROCHOICE VOTER ENDORSES VEDAT GASHI FOR CONGRESS

Choice Matters Rates Gashi 100% Pro-Choice.

NEW YORK – Yesterday, ProChoice Voter endorsed NY-16 Candidate Vedat Gashi for Congress. ProChoice Voter works to keep abortion legal and accessible for all women, regardless of age, race, class, status, geography or ability to pay. The organization joins a growing coalition supporting Gashi’s vision to deliver real results and real progress for the Bronx and Westchester.

“ProChoice Voter is proud to co-endorse Vedat Gashi for Congress. Gashi is a lifelong supporter of reproductive rights,” said ProChoice Voter Director Catherine Lederer-Plaskett. “As Vice Chairperson of the Legislature Committee, Legislator Vedat Gashi worked together with Choice Matters, and the bill’s sponsors, to pass the Westchester County Reproductive Health Care Facilities Access Act. This is a resounding victory that has taken over 12 years to accomplish and one that – given the huge uptick in violence and the overturning of Roe v. Wade – could not come at a more crucial time.”

“Women’s rights are human rights and as a proud girl dad and husband, this is personal to me and I am deeply committed to protecting a woman’s right to choose, to codifying Roe v. Wade and to securing legal and safe abortions in New York and across the country,” said NY-16 Candidate Vedat Gashi. “I am truly honored to have earned the endorsement of ProChoice Voter and rated 100% pro-choice by Choice Matters – I look forward to working together to ensure abortion is protected under the law as a fundamental right.”

As County Legislator, Gashi has implemented a series of policies and funding projects that have improved the quality of life for women and families. He passed a clinic access bill that protects women’s health and has delivered millions for childcare and affordable housing. He is committed to expanding crucial policies that provide families across the Bronx and Westchester access to affordable and quality health care including reproductive care.

ProChoice Voter joins a broad coalition of supporters that includes advocacy groups, elected officials, community leaders, labor unions, and clubs including Former Congresswoman Nita Lowey, Former Congressman Eliot Engel, NYS Assemblywoman Sandy Galef, NYS Assemblywoman Amy Paulin, Former New York Governor Paterson, Yonkers Mayor Mike Spano, Yonkers Democratic Party Chair Tom Meier, Westchester County Board of Legislators Chair Catherine Borgia, Westchester County Legislator Colin Smith, former Westchester Democratic Party Chair David Alpert, former Westchester Democratic Party Deputy Chair Bill Serratore, former Westchester County Legislators Alfreda Williams and Ruth Walter, Asbestos Workers Local 91, Boilermakers Local 5, Bricklayers Allied Crafts Local 5, Building Laborers Local 235, Westchester County Corrections Superior Officers Association, Building Trades Council, Dockbuilders Local 1556, Ironworkers Local 40, Ironworkers Local 417, Laborers Local 60, Northeast Regional Council of Carpenters Local 279, Operating Engineers Local 137, Ornamental Ironworkers Local 580, Painters District Council 9, Plumbers/Steamfitters Local 21, Road Sprinkler Local 669, Teamsters Local 456, Teamsters Local 813, Teamsters Local 814 and Tile, Marble, and Terrazzo Local 7.

About Vedat Gashi:

Vedat Gashi is a current Westchester County legislator who came to the U.S. as a refugee when his parents fled an oppressive regime in Kosovo. Raised in the Bronx and now raising his own family in Yorktown, Vedat has experienced the promise and hard realities of the American Dream. He knows what it’s like to grow up without food on the table, which is why he is focused on getting real results for us in our everyday priorities. And as a refugee from a country without democracy, it pains Vedat to see our leaders and Democrats fighting each other instead of working together to get things done. As a county legislator, Vedat has always delivered and worked with others to get results – putting people and everyday issues, not partisan politics, first. As the Chair of Appropriations, Vedat has built support for expanding services while cutting taxes, and in Congress, he will do the same. Vedat is focused on making real progress on the kitchen table issues like holding down taxes, lowering health care costs, strengthening our infrastructure, and improving our economy.

clean_body: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE August 11, 2022 Contact: Yuridia Peña, yuridia@altaconsulting.co, (718) 790-0837 PROCHOICE VOTER ENDORSES VEDAT GASHI FOR CONGRESS Choice Matters Rates Gashi 100% Pro-Choice. NEW YORK – Yesterday, ProChoice Voter endorsed NY-16 Candidate Vedat Gashi for Congress. ProChoice Voter works to keep abortion legal and accessible for all women, regardless of age, race, class, status, geography or ability to pay. The organization joins a growing coalition supporting Gashi’s vision to deliver real results and real progress for the Bronx and Westchester. “ProChoice Voter is proud to co-endorse Vedat Gashi for Congress. Gashi is a lifelong supporter of reproductive rights,” said ProChoice Voter Director Catherine Lederer-Plaskett. “As Vice Chairperson of the Legislature Committee, Legislator Vedat Gashi worked together with Choice Matters, and the bill’s sponsors, to pass the Westchester County Reproductive Health Care Facilities Access Act. This is a resounding victory that has taken over 12 years to accomplish and one that – given the huge uptick in violence and the overturning of Roe v. Wade – could not come at a more crucial time.” “Women’s rights are human rights and as a proud girl dad and husband, this is personal to me and I am deeply committed to protecting a woman’s right to choose, to codifying Roe v. Wade and to securing legal and safe abortions in New York and across the country,” said NY-16 Candidate Vedat Gashi. “I am truly honored to have earned the endorsement of ProChoice Voter and rated 100% pro-choice by Choice Matters – I look forward to working together to ensure abortion is protected under the law as a fundamental right.” As County Legislator, Gashi has implemented a series of policies and funding projects that have improved the quality of life for women and families. He passed a clinic access bill that protects women’s health and has delivered millions for childcare and affordable housing. He is committed to expanding crucial policies that provide families across the Bronx and Westchester access to affordable and quality health care including reproductive care. ProChoice Voter joins a broad coalition of supporters that includes advocacy groups, elected officials, community leaders, labor unions, and clubs including Former Congresswoman Nita Lowey, Former Congressman Eliot Engel, NYS Assemblywoman Sandy Galef, NYS Assemblywoman Amy Paulin, Former New York Governor Paterson, Yonkers Mayor Mike Spano, Yonkers Democratic Party Chair Tom Meier, Westchester County Board of Legislators Chair Catherine Borgia, Westchester County Legislator Colin Smith, former Westchester Democratic Party Chair David Alpert, former Westchester Democratic Party Deputy Chair Bill Serratore, former Westchester County Legislators Alfreda Williams and Ruth Walter, Asbestos Workers Local 91, Boilermakers Local 5, Bricklayers Allied Crafts Local 5, Building Laborers Local 235, Westchester County Corrections Superior Officers Association, Building Trades Council, Dockbuilders Local 1556, Ironworkers Local 40, Ironworkers Local 417, Laborers Local 60, Northeast Regional Council of Carpenters Local 279, Operating Engineers Local 137, Ornamental Ironworkers Local 580, Painters District Council 9, Plumbers/Steamfitters Local 21, Road Sprinkler Local 669, Teamsters Local 456, Teamsters Local 813, Teamsters Local 814 and Tile, Marble, and Terrazzo Local 7. About Vedat Gashi: Vedat Gashi is a current Westchester County legislator who came to the U.S. as a refugee when his parents fled an oppressive regime in Kosovo. Raised in the Bronx and now raising his own family in Yorktown, Vedat has experienced the promise and hard realities of the American Dream. He knows what it’s like to grow up without food on the table, which is why he is focused on getting real results for us in our everyday priorities. And as a refugee from a country without democracy, it pains Vedat to see our leaders and Democrats fighting each other instead of working together to get things done. As a county legislator, Vedat has always delivered and worked with others to get results – putting people and everyday issues, not partisan politics, first. As the Chair of Appropriations, Vedat has built support for expanding services while cutting taxes, and in Congress, he will do the same. Vedat is focused on making real progress on the kitchen table issues like holding down taxes, lowering health care costs, strengthening our infrastructure, and improving our economy. | Paid for by Gashi for Congress | Gashi for Congress PO Box 8202 White Plains NY 10602 United States If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please =.

subject: Charlottesville, Heather Heyer, and 5 Years After the White Supremacist Attack
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Lashrecse Aird
body:
https://www.lashrecseaird.com [https://www.lashrecseaird.com]
Friends,
Today is the five year anniversary that white supremacists and neo nazis descended on our beloved city of Charlottesville. Their sole mission was to divide us, strike fear into us, and prevent the progress we’ve worked so hard to attain. In their carnage of racist slogans, antisemitic hate, and misogynistic bigotry, one terrorist killed a young white woman named Heather Heyer. Heather was an ally to Black and brown people. She marched with us for racial and gender justice.
Get Involved [https://www.lashrecseaird.com/volunteer]
I woke up thinking about Heather today, and the tens of millions more women and men like her who come out in opposition to the hate expressed that day five years ago. For me, the story of Charlottesville isn’t just about the hate that occurred, it’s also about the power of unity in Virginia. As I served in the Virginia House of Delegates, I passed a resolution declaring racism a public health crisis. I recognized then how critical it was to stand against hate and racism, and I believe now more than ever that we need leaders who have lived the real life experiences of millions of Virginians.
Join our Policy Committee [https://www.lashrecseaird.com/policyteam]
Sadly, since 2017 we have seen a continued rise in right wing and white supremacist extremism. I firmly believe that we need leaders ready to rise to this challenge. Leaders with lived experiences in combating racism, passing legislation to stop systemic racism, and leading with empathy and compassion for marginalized and underrepresented communities. Charlottesville is a constant reminder of how critical it is for us to lift each other up and continue to stand united with justice. Heather Heyer showed us that when we unite as a coalition of Black, brown, and white Virginians, we can stand up against hate. That is our calling today. That is why I will continue to be a champion for all Virginians, against all forms of hate.
As I embark on this journey to serve you once again, I am grateful beyond words for your support. Now is the time to act. Let’s get to work.
Sincerely,
Lashrecse

| | | Dear Peter,

Farming is the backbone of our district and our country. I will always celebrate the American farmer, their work ethic, and the quality products they bring into our homes.

However, it’s hard for the American farmer to celebrate these days, as they’re facing more challenges than ever. From trade and market access, rising input costs, and supply chain issues, to concerns over rural broadband and aging transportation infrastructure, today’s farmers need an advocate in Washington who will address their concerns and work to make their jobs easier.

[That's why I am reaching out today to build my agriculture coalition; comprised of farmers, agribusiness leaders, and industry experts.](https://regan4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62755cae87ea324590220f153&id=c01adac22a&e=2fa613cb76) I need a strong coalition behind me who will stand up against the record high inflation under the Biden Administration (that Nikki Budzinski was a part of until just a year ago).

Their disastrous administration is taking our country back on a freight train in the wrong direction. Today’s inflation numbers hit a historic 41-year record high. Illinois farmers remember 41 years ago - the beginning of the worst farm economy since the Great Depression. Illinois farmers know Nikki is bad for business. That's why I am asking you today to join my Ag coalition team. [Sign up here:](https://regan4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62755cae87ea324590220f153&id=8e594c9b0c&e=2fa613cb76)

Dear Loyal Supporter,
It seems surreal, but we did it.
Despite having approximately six million dollars spent against me in the last three weeks, including four million in dark money from Super PACs, we won by a 0.5% margin.
We would not have won had it not been for generous, last-minute contributions that allowed us to expand our final TV buy and get a final mail piece out that landed the day before Election Day (approximately $100,000 in spending in the final days).
All of the money spent against me that made this race so difficult _came from the Republican Establishment and GOP Leader Kevin McCarthy._ They did everything they could to defeat me, but we prevailed because of your contributions.

Joe Kent

Hey there Peter--

It's Rich writing from Team Geels, and we don't know each other...

...and this message contains some political views.
What a way to start a conversation, you say.

[ Well, actually, I'm doing this for my friend

and candidate for Congress, Courtney Geels.

So here goes--- ]
You see, I wasn't always vocal like this,

and certainly not about elections.
But I spent the better part of my life with my family and school...

...and 30 years of it right here in the Triangle,

and so I care a lot about my neighborhood and my neighbors.

And I am sure you do as well...
Just look around us --

Higher prices for just about everything, everywhere...

our hard-earned tax money being given to wars we don't need to fight,

a southern border that looks worse than Swiss cheese, and massive illegal imigration...

...the list of policy-driven catastrophes grows longer by the minute.

If you see this and still love what our **CAREER POLITICIANS** are doing...

...then please stop reading now.

BUT, if you know without a doubt,

that THIS IS NOT THE AMERICA you remember...

... and this is not the nation we could be...
...then please --- **get to know my good friend Courtney Geels...**
Before we send YET ANOTHER CAREER POLITICIAN to tow the party lines... take a look at what Courtney is doing for this neighborhood and our country,

You just might be pleasantly surprised to see what **THE NURSE** has to offer.
That's all for now...

Be well, Rich Jay
**Team Geels**

I'd like you to watch my victory speech so you can see what my campaign is all about.
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60978927:JH2oRrVoN:m:1:3317145305:A118A89859EBCD36C3DA1363A1A003E7:r)
---
You see, Michigan is the birthplace of American ingenuity. We are the workers and the dreamers and the doers. But things have changed in our state, and not for the better.
---
Gretchen Whitmer and her far-Left policies have devastated Michigan over the last four years, and especially during her unscientific, tyrannical lockdowns in 2020.
---
An entire generation of students was set up for failure when Whitmer locked the doors to every school in our state.
---
People have lost their jobs, businesses, and life savings.
---
I've visited with the restaurant owners, the barbers, the florists, and the long list of small businesses and workers who were denied the ability to make a living because Whitmer thought she knew better.
---
I've talked with the men and women who lost their jobs, or closed their businesses, because they just couldn't make it work with the "closed by Whitmer" sign on the front door.
---
**The Queen of Lockdowns decided that YOU were not essential - and then she turned around and broke her own rules when it suited her. **
---
I lost my grandmother in a nursing home during Whitmer's lockdown, and I wasn't even allowed into the room to say goodbye. My daughters and I were forced to peek through a window.
---
These policies were cruel, and they did NOTHING to protect public health and safety.
---
It's been a long four years, but this November, we _finally_ have a chance to hold her accountable. We can _finally_ bring America First leadership to Michigan and get our state back on track.
---

**[_CONTRIBUTE TO FIRE WHITMER >>_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60978926:JH2oRrVoN:m:1:3317145305:A118A89859EBCD36C3DA1363A1A003E7:r)**
---

Whitmer is cheering every disastrous Biden policy that has plunged us into a recession.
---
She's driven the price of groceries through the roof. And that's just for the groceries you can actually find on the shelf! Baby formula? Who needs it, right?
---
Families are struggling just to put food on the table. But the truth is, Whitmer doesn't care!
---
Her policy proposals include shutting down pipelines, and she tried to RAISE the gas tax. She's an eager participant in Biden's insane war on our domestic energy industry.
---
_This comes at a time when the average gas price in Michigan is well over $4 a gallon!_
---
When Whitmer finally reopened our schools, she poisoned our children's minds with crazy left-wing anti-American ideas like critical race theory and radical gender theory.
---
She doesn't want parents to have any say in their children's education!
---
Whitmer has embraced the "spirit" of the defund-the-police movement, even as violent crime in Michigan increases at DOUBLE the rate of the national average.
---
She's happily put the safety of our communities in jeopardy to appease her far-Left base!
---
With a track record like that, you'd think her defeat would be assured in November...
---
_... but national Democrats are desperate to keep control of this key swing state. _
---
_They know it could decide the 2024 elections, so they want to make sure they have a far-Left puppet who can put her finger on the scales to hurt President Trump and swing the election towards Democrats._
---
That's why they've poured millions of dollars into Michigan to prop up Whitmer. She's currently sitting on a war chest of over $14.7 MILLION, and she's going to spend every penny of it to try to torpedo our surging campaign.
---
We need to be prepared for an onslaught of lying attack ads, and we need to secure the funds to FIGHT BACK. That's where you come in, Peter.
---

**[_HELP US FIGHT BACK >>_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60978926:JH2oRrVoN:m:1:3317145305:A118A89859EBCD36C3DA1363A1A003E7:r)**
---

I know you're a patriot who supports President Trump, Ron DeSantis, and other conservative leaders.
---
You believed in them and helped them win tough battles when no one thought it was possible.
---
Now, I need you to help me win what will be one of the toughest battles in the country this November.
---
I know something about tough battles. This primary was a tough fight. Fighting and beating breast cancer was a tough fight. Running and growing a Michigan-based steel company, as a woman, was tough. Watching my Nana locked away and left to die in a nursing home was tough.
---
_But as the saying goes, when the times get tough, the tough get going. I am tough, and I am just getting going._
---
With America First patriots like YOU fighting alongside me, we're going to take back our state from the radical Left and lay the groundwork to take back the White House in 2024.
---
The battlelines in this race couldn't be any clearer. This is going to be an epic fight between a conservative businesswoman and mother, and a far-Left birthing parent and career politician.
---
**_To win, I 'm going to need your support, Peter. I don't have liberal megadonors like Whitmer. Grassroots conservatives like you are all I've got. _**

body:
Yeah, we wanted to say it, too
| | | | |

| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, you saw it, right? **Because if you haven't seen the viral video of Beto O'Rourke responding to a Greg-Abbott supporting heckler as he talked about the somber reality of our children murdered by assault rifles...you must.** **_[THANK BETO for saying what must be said, and doing what must be done. Please join us in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Beto O'Rourke. Because we can't afford 2023 where he is not Governor of Texas.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc96b8947-ccb1-4a99-aa58-d5165fd8ad66/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)_** **_If you're exhausted by Democrats too often refusing to hit back, comment or message aggressively against Republicans who lie, cheat, steal, coup, take away our rights and pocket our taxes, it's a reminder of why we need the next generation of fighters in the Democratic Party to take over, and oh my, is Beto O'Rourke one of those._** Beto was speaking about assault rifles, and how they were weapons made for the battlefield--which every sane human including the creator of the assault rifle has acknowledged--the damage they do to little bodies in schools as they were made to pierce helmets of opposing soldiers. In fetid, disrespectful, and honestly abominable right-wing fashion, as he was talking about children being murdered by assault rifles, he was heckled by a Greg Abbott supporter in the crowd who started laughing.** ** **_Laughing at kids dying via assault rifle. Think about that._** **Then Beto responded the way we all wish we had, not like some polished politician but a real human with real emotions:** **_" It may be funny to you motherf***er but it's not funny to me."_**

Governor Bill Lee’s Education Savings Account Program (ESA) would use taxpayer money to provide vouchers for a select few eligible public school students in Nashville and Memphis that they could use to attend private schools. Donald Trump and the MAGA movement stand between them and their plans for American dictatorship. Their ambitions and agenda -- their very survival as a political party - depends on destroying Trump and his supporters. That's the truth behind their war on energy, gun control, open borders, school closures, vaccine mandates, and election takeovers.
**They are outlawing opposition and criminalizing democracy.**
The only thing that will stop them is a slam dunk, blowout election in November. Send every Democrat we can packing. Then, hold every Biden official who was in on this abuse of power accountable. Call them out by name and, if necessary, impeach them and their bosses. The Justice Department. The FBI. White House staff. EVERYONE.

Subsequently, generation after generation of our forefathers have watered our nation's tree of liberty with the blood of American martyrs. [_**NOW IS THE TIME TO ANSWER THE CALL!**_](https://libersend.loomered.com/l/bZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA/cdE763Jin82RFEgwRuGB6v8A/l0tkI1hA0DpIqNN07UCUdw) Dana's assault is a clarion call for Patriots everywhere to take a stand! Unlike Dana's dastardly deception, neither of those attacks came close to shaking the bedrock principles of the rule of law and impartial justice. [_**If Dana 's dictatorial action is successful it will transform America from a shining city on the hill to just another Chinese Communist concentration camp where freedom goes to die!**_](https://libersend.loomered.com/l/bZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA/cdE763Jin82RFEgwRuGB6v8A/l0tkI1hA0DpIqNN07UCUdw) Let tonight go down as a turning point - when the silent majority said "[_**ENOUGH!**_](https://libersend.loomered.com/l/bZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA/cdE763Jin82RFEgwRuGB6v8A/l0tkI1hA0DpIqNN07UCUdw) " When the socialist scum pushed us to the precipice and we collectively shouted, "[_**NO! No further!**_](https://libersend.loomered.com/l/bZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA/cdE763Jin82RFEgwRuGB6v8A/l0tkI1hA0DpIqNN07UCUdw) " Please join me in this noble crusade to save our great nation! If you do not act, tonight - I'm afraid there won't be a country left to defend much longer! I've put it all on the line - [_**Can I count on you now?**_](https://libersend.loomered.com/l/bZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA/cdE763Jin82RFEgwRuGB6v8A/l0tkI1hA0DpIqNN07UCUdw) Fighting for you,

Derek, Yesli Vega made headlines again last week. It wasn’t her radical stance on abortion this time though — this time it was the fact that she appeared on the same CPAC stage as Hungarian Dictator, Viktor Orbán. New York Magazine Intelligencer’s Profile:

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49099495/360807714/1064912967?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYmNhN2U1NS1hNDE5LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1lhOBe4MWo3doN07iLim-B8G7KuJ2cv7XlwzdzaVOGw=&emci=18205d8b-7c19-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=2bca7e55-a419-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=13556823)
---
**Peter — we want to make sure you have a chance to read New York Magazine Intelligencer’s profile of Dan.** We hope you’ll take a few minutes to read highlights from the interview below to learn more about Dan’s background, experience, and plans to shake up Congress. **[First, though, we need to ask you to donate to support our campaign.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49099496/360807729/-1219667055?refcode=em_GLD_FR_NYMagpiece_OOD_081122_cl_L1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYmNhN2U1NS1hNDE5LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1lhOBe4MWo3doN07iLim-B8G7KuJ2cv7XlwzdzaVOGw=)** We’re just 12 days away from our competitive primary election, and we have a budget gap to fill. **[RUSH A DONATION →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49099497/360807730/-1219667055?refcode=em_GLD_FR_NYMagpiece_OOD_081122_cl_b1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYmNhN2U1NS1hNDE5LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1lhOBe4MWo3doN07iLim-B8G7KuJ2cv7XlwzdzaVOGw=)**
* * *
**Dan Goldman on the Problem With Trump, Republicans, and Members of His Own Party The veteran federal prosecutor tries politics.** -Nia Prater _“The last time Dan Goldman was in the House, he was impeaching Donald Trump. As the lead counsel in the first impeachment inquiry, he questioned witnesses for the Intelligence Committee. Now he wants to return as a representative of New York’s Tenth District, covering parts of Manhattan and Brooklyn._ _Goldman, 46, is a veteran federal prosecutor who served under Preet Bharara in Manhattan, where he prosecuted mobsters and white-collar-fraud cases for a decade, before he was tapped by House Democrats in 2019. His pitch to voters is that this experience has prepared him to preserve the nation’s democracy against a Trump return. He’s in a tight race in the Democratic primary on August 23.”_ **[DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49099498/360807731/-1219667055?refcode=em_GLD_FR_NYMagpiece_OOD_081122_cl_b2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYmNhN2U1NS1hNDE5LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1lhOBe4MWo3doN07iLim-B8G7KuJ2cv7XlwzdzaVOGw=)** **“You’ve had an extensive legal career. Why transition to politics?”** “I look around the country and I’m frightened by the attacks on the basic democratic foundations of our country, and I am very scared for the future of our democracy. I think that too many people, including Democrats, don’t recognize the degree to which Donald Trump is still in control of the party and is laying the foundation to steal the 2024 election. And I am devastated by the rollback of our right to choose and the foreshadowing of future rollbacks of our fundamental rights. And I felt compelled as a public servant to jump in this race to see if I could use my unique skills and experience to go back to Washington and stand up to Trump again, and the Republican Party, and make sure that we continue to have a democracy.” **[DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49099499/360807732/-1219667055?refcode=em_GLD_FR_NYMagpiece_OOD_081122_cl_b3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYmNhN2U1NS1hNDE5LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1lhOBe4MWo3doN07iLim-B8G7KuJ2cv7XlwzdzaVOGw=)** **“Prior to this seat opening up, you launched a campaign to run for state attorney general but later dropped out and endorsed Letitia James for reelection. What was behind that decision?”** “I think Tish James is doing a good job, and I wasn’t interested in running against her. Many of the same reasons why I’m running for Congress now were the same reasons that I threw my hat in the ring for attorney general — I think there are lots of ways to serve the public. And there are lots of ways to promote democracy and stand up for the vulnerable communities and people who don’t have access to the opportunities that every American should have. One way is to be attorney general, and another way is to run for Congress. But at the core, it was born out of the same desire that I’ve had for my entire career: to be a public servant.” **[DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49099500/360807733/-1219667055?refcode=em_GLD_FR_NYMagpiece_OOD_081122_cl_b4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYmNhN2U1NS1hNDE5LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1lhOBe4MWo3doN07iLim-B8G7KuJ2cv7XlwzdzaVOGw=)** **“Your opponents have a largely political background on either the local level or the federal level. What makes you the best suited to represent NY-10?”** “Well, it’s a combination of the fact that I am the only one who has stood up to Donald Trump. I’ve been effective at doing so and proving the case. But I bring some strategies and ideas that we used effectively in the impeachment investigation but are easily transferable to passing legislation and to delivering results for our communities and our constituents. I think having been in Washington and understanding how Congress works, understanding that this Republican Party is different than our parents’ Republican Party — they’re not good-faith actors. So we need to use different tactics to bring them to the table because the same old playbook is not working. And so what I bring is a fresh and different approach that is different from my opponents, who are more conventional and typical politicians who seem to be using the same playbook that Democrats have used for a long time that are no longer working in Washington. They work well in City Hall. They work well in Albany because you have supermajorities of Democrats. clean_body: New York Magazine Intelligencer’s Profile: | Peter — we want to make sure you have a chance to read New York Magazine Intelligencer’s profile of Dan. We hope you’ll take a few minutes to read highlights from the interview below to learn more about Dan’s background, experience, and plans to shake up Congress. = We’re just 12 days away from our competitive primary election, and we have a budget gap to fill. = Dan Goldman on the Problem With Trump, Republicans, and Members of His Own Party The veteran federal prosecutor tries politics. -Nia Prater “The last time Dan Goldman was in the House, he was impeaching Donald Trump. As the lead counsel in the first impeachment inquiry, he questioned witnesses for the Intelligence Committee. Now he wants to return as a representative of New York’s Tenth District, covering parts of Manhattan and Brooklyn. Goldman, 46, is a veteran federal prosecutor who served under Preet Bharara in Manhattan, where he prosecuted mobsters and white-collar-fraud cases for a decade, before he was tapped by House Democrats in 2019. His pitch to voters is that this experience has prepared him to preserve the nation’s democracy against a Trump return. He’s in a tight race in the Democratic primary on August 23.” = “You’ve had an extensive legal career. Why transition to politics?” “I look around the country and I’m frightened by the attacks on the basic democratic foundations of our country, and I am very scared for the future of our democracy. I think that too many people, including Democrats, don’t recognize the degree to which Donald Trump is still in control of the party and is laying the foundation to steal the 2024 election. And I am devastated by the rollback of our right to choose and the foreshadowing of future rollbacks of our fundamental rights. And I felt compelled as a public servant to jump in this race to see if I could use my unique skills and experience to go back to Washington and stand up to Trump again, and the Republican Party, and make sure that we continue to have a democracy.” = “Prior to this seat opening up, you launched a campaign to run for state attorney general but later dropped out and endorsed Letitia James for reelection. What was behind that decision?” “I think Tish James is doing a good job, and I wasn’t interested in running against her. Many of the same reasons why I’m running for Congress now were the same reasons that I threw my hat in the ring for attorney general — I think there are lots of ways to serve the public. And there are lots of ways to promote democracy and stand up for the vulnerable communities and people who don’t have access to the opportunities that every American should have. One way is to be attorney general, and another way is to run for Congress. But at the core, it was born out of the same desire that I’ve had for my entire career: to be a public servant.” = “Your opponents have a largely political background on either the local level or the federal level. What makes you the best suited to represent NY-10?” “Well, it’s a combination of the fact that I am the only one who has stood up to Donald Trump. I’ve been effective at doing so and proving the case. But I bring some strategies and ideas that we used effectively in the impeachment investigation but are easily transferable to passing legislation and to delivering results for our communities and our constituents. I think having been in Washington and understanding how Congress works, understanding that this Republican Party is different than our parents’ Republican Party — they’re not good-faith actors. So we need to use different tactics to bring them to the table because the same old playbook is not working. And so what I bring is a fresh and different approach that is different from my opponents, who are more conventional and typical politicians who seem to be using the same playbook that Democrats have used for a long time that are no longer working in Washington. They work well in City Hall. They work well in Albany because you have supermajorities of Democrats. So the challenges are different.” = “You say that Republicans in Congress are not acting in good faith. Considering that there’s a significant chance that, if elected, you’ll be entering the House controlled by them, how do you work to get things done?” “If the Democrats are in the minority, which I hope we are not, my experience having led the impeachment investigation will be even more valuable to the party because we can expect an impeachment investigation into Joe Biden. We can expect a number of tangential select committees that are stood up to investigate political nonsense. And so my experience having been a prosecutor and leading the Trump impeachment will be even more valuable to the party to be a bulwark against overreach and unwarranted investigations. From my experience down there, you can be aggressive with the opposing party, but you can also work with them at the same time. And so while I have called for an aggressive investigation into gun manufacturers and gun dealers, who control the Republican Party — because I want to expose what they know about their marketing and advertising, and how it has radicalized young people who buy AR-15s and increasingly commit mass shootings, in order to put some pressure on the Republicans through their special interests — I also think we can work together on things like early-childhood development, which traditionally has been bipartisan, and renewable energy as an example because it saves the climate and it creates jobs. Republicans are increasingly talking about energy independence, and the best way to have energy independence is to invest in renewable energy. So we need to reframe the message or the approach to Republicans so they understand that it is in their self interest to come to the table. Flashy headlines. Fluffed up news. Explosive attacks.

_I’m sick of it. And I know you are too._

Every fundraising email you get probably looks the same, and it’s driving us into massive information overload and missing the point.

Politics isn’t a sports league. It’s not about getting your side to “win” for the purpose of glory and fame points.

**Serving in Congress is about putting in work for the American people and getting real results that YOU can see in your everyday life. That is my only goal - and that is the only reason I need your help.**

I promise you the dollars you donate aren’t going into drumming up fake drama or winning the favor of big Washington lobbyists.

**Your money goes to supporting the volunteers knocking on doors for hours. It’s going to delivering a yard sign to the elderly woman who is so excited to vote but can’t get to campaign headquarters herself. It’s going to giving water bottles to the citizens who stood outside for hours in the Virginia heat to attend their first political rally.**

body:
This is a super important deadline, and we don’t want to fall short. Wondering if you can help.
#
**🚨 MAJOR MID-MONTH FUNDRAISING DEADLINE 🚨**
---
DEADLINE: 8/15 | GOAL: $275,000
**[Quick Donate $5 →](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/48481?refcode=em20220811-6817&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6817%2E434096%2EH-7J0C)**
In 4 days, we’ll hit our mid-month fundraising deadline. With just 3 months until E-Day, we need to hit every single financial goal we set just to be able to fund the advertising, organizing, and outreach we’ve _already_ planned for the final sprint.
**Put simply... we need $275,000 between now and the deadline.** And, yes Derek , we know that not everyone can donate every single time we ask.
That’s OK. But think about this... if even 1 out of every 5 people reading this email donated to John right this second, we’d hit our goal before the end of the night with _time to spare_. Grassroots campaigns only work if enough people decide to get involved to make them happen.
So we’re asking you right now:
[**_Derek, will you be the one person reading this email right now to make a quick donation to elect John Fetterman? Even if you can only give a little bit, please do. Combined with everyone else’s donations, it’ll add up._**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/48481?refcode=em20220811-6817&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=6817%2E434096%2EH-7J0C)

Derek, the last thing you want to do is wake up the day after the election having lost by 1% and seeing there was money left in the campaign bank account you _didn’t_ spend.
That’s why **we’ve already budgeted every single dollar** we need to raise to win. So if we can’t hit this week’s mid-month goal, that plan goes out the window and we’ve got to start cutting back. That’s why we’re emailing today and hoping you can be that one person to come through.
[**_Please, if you can, make a quick donation to elect John Fetterman so we can reach our goal before the mid-month deadline._**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/48481?refcode=em20220811-6817&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=6817%2E434096%2EH-7J0C)
Whether you can chip in or not, we’re glad you’re part of the team. Without this grassroots funding, there’s simply no way we could run a competitive campaign.
Thank you!!
\- Team Fetterman HQ 💛

subject: Holding Lawless, Woke Prosecutors Accountable
body:
To view this email as a web page, go to the link below, or copy and paste it into your browser's address window.
https://view.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=d0591b705ab12e4df17fe0a71632e4cefd678b45a89642e52cf358eb8cbbf8537de275a07a0b8a5827e2a08664bb02d3af83ab67ea430edbb86ea0e68c7a222902238abab17440174f1d07a38e67fc43

Peter,

You’ve seen across the country a wave of woke prosecutors funded by out of state interests refusing to uphold the rule of law who are allowing criminals to walk free without ever facing consequences for their crimes. As Governor, I have made it clear: In this state, we uphold the rule of law. We respect the law enforcement officers who put their lives on the line every day to keep our communities safe.

We DO NOT allow woke activist prosecutors to abdicate their duty to do their job and protect their communities. This is why I took action to right the wrongs of a prosecutor whose conduct has fallen below the standard that is required by the Florida Constitution by refusing to enforce laws he doesn’t like. A prosecutor is not a law unto himself.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=14136fae826e046f00854e9e1163b0e18f423a3e3b16ba0d1f8edb2567bbe96066f79bace908c68ea998eb46c93f3cd7d8e28b1b17a39ef96a4d5a0c36824249
UPHOLD THE RULE OF LAW >>>

We are not going to allow this pathogen of ignoring the law that's been going on around the country to get a foothold in the state of Florida. We are going to make sure that our laws are enforced and that no individual prosecutor puts themselves above the law.

It’s simple. If you put yourself above the law, you are violating and neglecting your duty and you are displaying a lack of competence to be able to perform those duties. If you abandon the duties of your oath of office, you no longer have the right to hold that office.

The crime in places like San Francisco and Los Angeles are out of control. Police are unable to do their jobs, businesses are closing up shop, and violent criminals are walking free all because of the dereliction of duty by prosecutors who are funded by ideological activists. In Florida, we’re not going to sit idly by and watch our state spiral into chaos. We’re going to respect our law enforcement officers, we’re going to protect our citizens, and we’re going to enforce the law.

As your Governor, I will not stand for woke prosecutors, who are entrusted with enforcing the law, showing more deference and care for criminals than the victims of their crimes in the name of “social justice.” Denying a victim their day in court is not justice. Allowing a criminal to walk free of consequence for their crimes is not justice. It is, in fact, the opposite of justice.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=14136fae826e046f00854e9e1163b0e18f423a3e3b16ba0d1f8edb2567bbe96066f79bace908c68ea998eb46c93f3cd7d8e28b1b17a39ef96a4d5a0c36824249
REJECT WOKE PROSECUTORS >>>

Florida is a law-and-order state. I am not going to back down from that one inch. The radical Left is already attacking me for doing my job to ensure that the laws are enforced in our state. They are going to use my suspension of a state attorney refusing to do his job to appeal to the members of the woke mob and add to their war chest.

Like I’ve said before, Peter, I will never allow political favor to sway my resolve to do what’s right. I need to know that I can count on your support as I prepare to go head on against the Democrats’ crusade against law and order.

Peter, As you may know, Ohio Republicans have enacted legislation that outlaws abortion as early as six weeks into pregnancy, before many women are aware that they are pregnant. The law often doesn’t include doesn’t include exceptions for rape, incest or fetal anomalies. **** Yesterday, we held an event with OBGYNs and other doctors from hospitals all over Northeast Ohio. They told me about how the Ohio law is preventing them not only from doing their jobs, but also tying their hands from giving life saving medical treatments to women all over the state.

Under Ohio law, women that need health care can't get health care. So these doctors are not allowed to give life saving health care due to politics in the exam room. It’s like having a life-saving super power that politicians force you not to use. The providers I met are angry and want to fight for their patients. They want to save people’s lives, but if they help they face strict legal penalties including possible jail time. These doctors are going home after work and spending hours and hours coordinating for their patients to get treatment out of state. Sadly, many of these heroic providers are having mental health trauma because they have to tell their patients that they can’t give them the life-saving care they need. Instead of providing the doctors with the ability to give life saving care, the hospitals are telling them to just get counseling and keep working. We can overturn the barbaric Ohio law and allow care providers to use their expertise to save patients. In Washington, I will prioritize codifying abortion protections into federal law so the Ohio abortion ban won't apply. # Mysterious Cash Floods Upstate New York GOP Primary as Establishment Races to Stop Carl Paladino
_A mysterious Super PAC has flooded upstate New York with attack ads trying to stop the insurgent campaign of brash businessman and political outsider Carl Paladino, Federal Election Commission (FEC) filings show._ The donors to the group, [named](https://CarlPaladino.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3bf22d0f57d54fb47b0038eb8&id=49662e4f60&e=7e49f828ab) American Liberty Action PAC, will not be publicly known until after the upcoming Aug. 23 GOP primary where Paladino faces off against the more establishment-backed New York GOP chairman, Nick Langworthy, in a primary for New York’s 23rd congressional district. But the group has spent hundreds of thousands of dollars—$344,354 to be precise—attacking Paladino in the primary. It has also spent $9,400 in favor of Langworthy, per FEC filings compiled by the Center for Responsive Politics. Paladino blasted the secretive spending in a statement to Breitbart News ripping his opponent Langworthy for benefitting from it. “Nick Langworthy has shamefully lied to voters about having President Trump’s endorsement,” Paladino said. “He has also told NY Republican candidates, according to Rudy Guliani, not to mention Trump’s name. Now, he is enlisting the help of a Never Trump-backed shady Super PAC, with dark money donors. This same Super PAC has ties to pro-impeachment members. The establishment is doing everything they can to oppose me, because they know I will fight for the America First agenda and unlike my opponent, I cannot be bought.”

[(Read the full article)](https://CarlPaladino.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3bf22d0f57d54fb47b0038eb8&id=b86a5fd42b&e=7e49f828ab)
