DIEHL AND ALLEN ANNOUNCE SUPPORT FOR EXPANDED SCHOOL CHOICE
BOSTON, Mass. - Geoff Diehl and Leah Allen, the Republican party's endorsed candidates for Governor and Lieutenant Governor of Massachusetts, issued a call today for expanded school choice across the Bay State.
"Right now, there are many families across our state, particularly in inner cities, where students are being under-served by the public school system available to them," Diehl said. "Leah Allen and I are committed to improving all of our public schools to make them world-class learning institutions. That's our first priority; we fully support our public schools and the funding they need. But we also support providing alternatives to families who conclude that public education isn't the best option for their students. We firmly back school choice for Massachusetts families."
According to Diehl, he and Leah Allen support making school choice universal across Massachusetts. Parents who choose to withdraw their child from public schools will be able to use a portion of the per-pupil funds allotted to their child by the state toward tuition at private schools, parochial schools and home schooling. The money would be available through newly-established Education Savings Accounts. This concept means parents who feel their child is under-served by their local public school will be able to afford to choose a more appropriate option. Diehl and Allen also support lifting the state charter school cap. And, they support expanding the availability and depth of vocational education opportunities offered by public schools.
Recent reports indicate that there has been an exodus of students away from public schools in recent years. Statewide, public school enrollment reportedly has decreased four percent since 2019, with nearly three-quarters of school districts reporting a decline. In the City of Boston, public school enrollment reportedly has dropped 14 percent over the past five years. At the same time, the number of small schools is growing, with students seeking education opportunities in charter schools, vocational schools, private schools, and at-home learning.
"Basically, we believe in promoting the freedom to make alternative education decisions, and in those cases, the dollars will follow the child," Diehl said.
"Our state has an obligation to support the education of every student, regardless of the mode of education they decide works best for them," Allen said. "Geoff Diehl and I want to make sure every family is supported by the state when they make decisions for their children, including where they will learn and what curriculum they will be taught. For some students, that will be in a traditional public school setting, and we support them. For others, that will be in an alternative school setting, and we will support them too. We believe we can improve our public schools by fully-funding them and providing adequate resources for their mission, while at the same time providing additional private school options to Massachusetts families who wish to pursue those opportunities."
Diehl and Allen announced their plans during a press conference in Boston's North End together with South Dakota Governor Kristi Noem. Earlier this year, Governor Noem signed legislation into law expanding school choice in South Dakota, providing additional tax credits for families pursuing private school education for their children.
"Governor Noem has been a leader on the issue of school choice nationwide, and we hope to follow her strong example on this important issue," Diehl said.
Noem is in Boston to support Diehl's campaign and publicly endorsed his candidacy for Governor.
Jay McMahon, the Republican candidate for Attorney General, also joined Diehl, Allen, and Noem at the press conference.

clean_body: | | | | DIEHL AND ALLEN ANNOUNCE SUPPORT FOR EXPANDED SCHOOL CHOICE BOSTON, Mass. - Geoff Diehl and Leah Allen, the Republican party's endorsed candidates for Governor and Lieutenant Governor of Massachusetts, issued a call today for expanded school choice across the Bay State. "Right now, there are many families across our state, particularly in inner cities, where students are being under-served by the public school system available to them," Diehl said. "Leah Allen and I are committed to improving all of our public schools to make them world-class learning institutions. That's our first priority; we fully support our public schools and the funding they need. But we also support providing alternatives to families who conclude that public education isn't the best option for their students. We firmly back school choice for Massachusetts families." According to Diehl, he and Leah Allen support making school choice universal across Massachusetts. Parents who choose to withdraw their child from public schools will be able to use a portion of the per-pupil funds allotted to their child by the state toward tuition at private schools, parochial schools and home schooling. The money would be available through newly-established Education Savings Accounts. This concept means parents who feel their child is under-served by their local public school will be able to afford to choose a more appropriate option. Diehl and Allen also support lifting the state charter school cap. And, they support expanding the availability and depth of vocational education opportunities offered by public schools. Recent reports indicate that there has been an exodus of students away from public schools in recent years. Statewide, public school enrollment reportedly has decreased four percent since 2019, with nearly three-quarters of school districts reporting a decline. In the City of Boston, public school enrollment reportedly has dropped 14 percent over the past five years. At the same time, the number of small schools is growing, with students seeking education opportunities in charter schools, vocational schools, private schools, and at-home learning. "Basically, we believe in promoting the freedom to make alternative education decisions, and in those cases, the dollars will follow the child," Diehl said. "Our state has an obligation to support the education of every student, regardless of the mode of education they decide works best for them," Allen said. "Geoff Diehl and I want to make sure every family is supported by the state when they make decisions for their children, including where they will learn and what curriculum they will be taught. For some students, that will be in a traditional public school setting, and we support them. For others, that will be in an alternative school setting, and we will support them too. We believe we can improve our public schools by fully-funding them and providing adequate resources for their mission, while at the same time providing additional private school options to Massachusetts families who wish to pursue those opportunities." Diehl and Allen announced their plans during a press conference in Boston's North End together with South Dakota Governor Kristi Noem. Earlier this year, Governor Noem signed legislation into law expanding school choice in South Dakota, providing additional tax credits for families pursuing private school education for their children. "Governor Noem has been a leader on the issue of school choice nationwide, and we hope to follow her strong example on this important issue," Diehl said. Noem is in Boston to support Diehl's campaign and publicly endorsed his candidacy for Governor. body:
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49101617/360816857/-1698714710?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ2NjU3ZTExLWFlMTktZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9Jt4d_bcLJxb32sUpfF562daonmBmyXqTXzqRRj_lSk=&emci=c12c2c5d-a819-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=d6657e11-ae19-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) | | | Friend, If you’ve been reading our emails, then you already know that the Inflation Reduction Act is nearly across the finish line. This historic investment in fighting the impacts of climate change has already passed the U.S. Senate and will be voted on in the House as soon as tomorrow. The Inflation Reduction Act is the strongest action the federal government has ever taken to address climate change, but there is still a lot of work to be done, especially at the state level. That’s why I’m writing to you today—**we are working alongside our partners to ensure that Oregon continues its transition toward a just and equitable climate future.** [**Will you make a donation today to help? Your donation, no matter the amount, makes a difference.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49101618/360816858/-1698714710?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ2NjU3ZTExLWFlMTktZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9Jt4d_bcLJxb32sUpfF562daonmBmyXqTXzqRRj_lSk=&emci=c12c2c5d-a819-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=d6657e11-ae19-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) Passing this landmark legislation would be a huge milestone in the fight for climate action. It will put the U.S. on track to cut carbon emissions by up to 40% by 2030 by investing in clean, renewable energy and creating millions of jobs in the process. Oregon should be proud of the role that our state has played in its passage through the Senate. Senators Wyden and Merkley have been champions of the bill and have shown Oregon to be a leader in the fight for climate action. We should also be proud of all of the work that OLCV volunteers and staff have done to get this bill across the finish line. Our volunteers have written Letters to the Editor and op-eds urging our elected leaders to pass the bill. We hosted six virtual town hall events with Senators Wyden and Merkley and Representatives Earl Blumenauer and Suzanne Bonamici, drawing as many as 300 attendees at a time. Our members took action—sending over 3,000 emails to Oregon’s congressional delegation. All of this incredible work by OLCV volunteers and staff has had a huge impact. **As we prepare for the next steps—implementation of the Inflation Reduction Act and continuing to push Oregon forward—**[**will you make a donation to help?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49101619/360816859/-1698714710?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ2NjU3ZTExLWFlMTktZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9Jt4d_bcLJxb32sUpfF562daonmBmyXqTXzqRRj_lSk=&emci=c12c2c5d-a819-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=d6657e11-ae19-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) We’ve come so far but we’ve still got a lot of work ahead of us, and we need your help to do it. Thanks for all you do. Sincerely,
April Christenson
OLCV Development Director |

name: Team Heidi Campbell
subject: About Andy Ogles
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Campbell for Congress
body:
https://www.voteheidicampbell.com/ [https://www.voteheidicampbell.com/]
Peter,
The race for the 5th Congressional District is heating up and it’s important for you to know more about Senator Campbell’s opponent, Andy Ogles.
Andy has been trying his luck as a far right politician in Tennessee for a very long time. He first ran for Congress in 2002, but was rejected by Republican voters. Later, he worked on Newt Gingrich’s presidential campaign and then for Americans for Prosperity. Yes, the Koch-funded super PAC that pushes trickle-down economics and other extreme policies that shortchange working families.
Ogles brags about his time working for the Koch’s when he lobbied the state legislature to give big corporations and Wall Street a huge new tax break. His “win” was a loss for local governments struggling to fund our public schools, fight crime and replace aging infrastructure.
In 2018, he flirted with the idea of challenging U.S. Sen. Bob Corker in a Republican Primary, but wimped out and decided to run for mayor of Maury County. He won and started calling himself Tennessee’s “most conservative” mayor.
Last month, he insulted local leaders by vetoing the entire county budget just to defund the library because he didn’t like a book display featuring LGBTQ writers.
We need Heidi Campbell so we can avoid a public disaster with Andy Ogles in Congress. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbellemail]
As a candidate for Congress, Ogles cheered when the Supreme Court overruled Roe v. Wade and gun safety laws. He says he wants to shut down the Dept. of Education, which provides key support for students with disabilities, teacher development and rural schools.
He has denied the results of the 2020 election and is already campaigning for Trump to run again. He is calling for President Biden’s impeachment.
In Congress, Andy Ogles is a guaranteed vote for a national ban on abortion and his record shows he won’t stand up for working families if it displeases his billionaire campaign donors.
It is time to stand up for Tennessee and say a resounding “NO” to Andy Ogles and his ultra MAGA agenda.
Stand with Heidi Campbell and fight for freedom for families first! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbellemail]
Our campaign is focused on solving problems and getting results. We can bring our fight for working and middle class families to Congress, but we need your help. This is a winnable race but it is going to be a knock down drag out fight all the way through November.
If you remember the nasty ads from just a few weeks ago in the GOP primary, just wait to see what Andy sends out going after Senator Campbell. Please chip in to fight back against the vicious attacks we know are coming! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbellemail]
Thanks,
Team Campbell

body:

| | **Hi, it’s DLCC President Jessica Post.** Between the Supreme Court's decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , the RSLC's staggering fundraising, and Republicans targeting Democrat-held state legislatures, these past few months have tested our grassroots movement. But across the country, Democrats are working together to make their voices heard and standing up to the GOP’s right-wing extremism – just _look_ at what we’ve accomplished so far:
* Kansas voters **rejected a ballot initiative that would have removed the right to an abortion** from the state's constitution.

Peter,

I knew that attacks would be coming our way, but I didn't expect this:

Over the weekend, we got word that some unmarked mailers had made their way to voters’ mailboxes. They contained some pretty heinous attacks on "E.R.I.C" -- an “Extreme Radical Indoctrinating Children” --_I wonder who that might be?_

**The obvious implication is that because I'm gay, a vote for me means a vote for "sexual perversion" against children. Oh, and they threw in an illustration of a terrified kid for good measure:**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49082734/360773537/-295409223?refcode=em-8.11.22-nopen-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNjNhNzViOS04ZTE5LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=iYXz9hGLfz7HU6xYpbEooipX4PRcJOyhbEaq22_b6z8=)
This is sickening, but it's not shocking -- and I'm not holding my breath for my opponent Esther King to comment about this homophobic attack.

**The truth is that the GOP has a longstanding policy of embracing this kind of hateful rhetoric. I grew up in an era when homophobic scare tactics were normal. It’s a shame we’re reverting back to this sort of shameful bigotry.**

I've got thick skin, Peter. If anything, this a reminder that our campaign is bigger than just flipping a House seat -- this is about standing up to the extremism and hate that’s only grown in recent years. We need to restore some decency to the halls of Congress. That's why I'm running, and it's why I need your support:

**[The far-right is clearly willing to do whatever it takes to crush our momentum. I’m hoping you can make a $5 contribution to help us fight back and win this seat. Derek —
[](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20220811-dejoy-petition.gpss-G&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20220811_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=650%2E5257348%2E2RxsKV)
Donald Trump’s handpicked Postmaster General Louis DeJoy just announced his plan to slash **_50,000 jobs_** from USPS. Remember, this is the same guy who:
* Left his job as finance chair at the Republican National Committee to take this position
* Helped Donald Trump undermine vote-by-mail by slowing down mail delivery and decommissioning mail ballot sorting machines right before the 2020 election
* Remains at odds with the White House and Environmental Protection Agency’s recommendations to replace aging gas-powered USPS vehicles with fully electric ones

The list goes on. And you might be wondering, “Why does this guy hate the USPS so much?” Well, there’s also this: **DeJoy’s family business includes direct competitors with the Postal Service.**
It’s clear what he’s trying to do. Destroy the USPS from within, in order to gain political points from Trump and his acolytes but also to profit financially.
**Enough is enough.** With President Biden’s nominees confirmed, the USPS Board of Governors finally has the power to fire DeJoy and replace him with a competent, nonpartisan leader, and they’ve got to do it now.
[**Add your name to my petition demanding the USPS Board of Governors remove Trump's handpicked Postmaster General Louis DeJoy before he can do any more damage.**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20220811-dejoy-petition.gpss-G&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20220811_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=650%2E5257348%2E2RxsKV)

| Dear Fellow American,

As an informed conservative, you know how Judicial Watch works hard every day to fight _for_ the rule of law and _against_ public corruption and unlawful government secrecy...
...and I think you also know that in these fights _every dollar counts_.
[That's why I urgeyou to give Judicial Watch your support today!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59736&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)

---

The impact of our work has never been more important.

* **_We continue to be the most effective voice in the country for commonsense safeguards to keep our elections honest_. **

We have sued the state of **Illinois** to block state election officials there from extending Election Day for 14 days beyond the date established by federal law...a move that is both illegal _and_ that encourages fraud, and we are now suing **New York State** and **New****York City** for the City's failure to clean its voter rolls between elections, as federal law requires.

* **_We continue to be the "only game in town" when it comes to pulling back the curtain of secrecy surrounding Biden family corruption_****.**

We recently were back in federal court, filing a new lawsuit against the Department of Homeland Security for Secret Service records related to travel and security costs for **Hunter Biden**. Congress and the liberal media look the other way, but we continue our investigations and litigation into serious allegations of **Biden family corruption** , centering on the overseas influence-peddling schemes engineered by Hunter that may have benefitted his father, **Joe Biden.**

* **_We continue to be the most effective voice in the country for exposing the use of taxpayer dollars to fund Critical Race Theory (CRT) teaching_**. We forced the release of documents from the Defense Department showing that **CRT** propaganda is being used in classroom materials at the **S. Military Academy (West Point)**. And we recently sued the Defense Department over its failure to release to us records related to the **U.S. Naval Academy** implementing **CRT** in the training of naval recruits!

The generous support we receive from our members is an essential cornerstone of our patriotic mission...

...and the need for quick Judicial Watch action through the courts frequently arise suddenly and without warning.

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59736&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)
---

The Left is not letting up one bit in corruptly using its power to radically transform America...and as our investigations and lawsuits prove, they will use any tool, including unlawful government secrecy and censorship of conservative voices, to achieve their goal.

I can think of no group better able to counter these forces than Judicial Watch...especially if you will join the Judicial Watch family of supporters today!

[Your special gift today will help us respond effectively as we fight for you and for America.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59736&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)

I look forward to welcoming you to the Judicial Watch team!

Sincerely,

Tom Fitton

[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek — it’s Jack
DeLapp, Stacey Abrams’ Director of Strategy, Targeting and Metrics. By
now, you’ve heard that we’re facing more than $1 million in attack ads
from Brian Kemp. But I want to show you a strategic map of Georgia so you
can see what we’re doing to counter them.

When campaigns put ads on the air, they have to pay per media market, so
some campaigns only pay to advertise in places they’re sure they can win.

However, since we're facing a wave of lying attack ads from Brian Kemp, we
need to reach voters in every corner of Georgia, in every media market —
not just Atlanta — to set the record straight.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1619?refcode=sa_em_220811_B1_Jack_S1_T1_HQ_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=1405%2E1862389%2E3vHtdR ]Airing our TV ads — in addition to radio and online ads — while running
a direct voter contact program is extremely expensive. That’s why we’re
counting on
supporters like you
to take a look at this map and chip in $5 to make sure we

body:
Dear Friends,

Thank you for joining us last night to share our progress for working families, historic health care for burn pit veterans, and the fight for our freedoms.

As Assistant Speaker Katherine Clark and I discussed, with the slimmest of Congressional majorities, the Democratic Party has delivered record results.

From COVID relief to jobs and infrastructure, to climate action and gun violence prevention, and to health care to veterans and military families, our progress is meeting people’s needs and putting working families over entrenched special interests — and we’re not done yet!

Good policy makes good politics: Democrats’ midterm message is resonating with voters who want people over politics. For a good summary of our progress for working families and fight for our freedoms, please read this recent column by Washington Post columnist Jennifer Rubin: “Pelosi Has Found The Democrats’ Midterm Strategy” — https://www.washingtonpost.com/opinions/2022/08/10/pelosi-has-found-democrats-midterm-strategy/

As always, I accept every compliment about our collective work on behalf of the courageous House Democrats and you, our grassroots VIPs — volunteers in politics and policy — who create a drumbeat for progress across the country and make all our successes possible.
Thank you,

NANCY

Opinion: Pelosi has found the Democrats’ midterm strategy
By Jennifer Rubin
August 10, 2022

As Republicans whipped themselves up into new levels of fury on Tuesday over the execution of a search warrant at former president Donald Trump’s Mar-a-Lago estate in Florida, Democrats were taking victory laps and spelling out their midterm message.

House Speaker Nancy Pelosi (D-Calif.), who has remained unflappably upbeat about the midterms, now has good reason to tout Democrats’ prospects. Even when other issues have popped up (e.g., impeachment of Trump for inciting an attack on the U.S. Capitol), Pelosi has consistently been an advocate for running on “kitchen table” issues, as she regularly puts it, such as lowering the cost of health insurance premiums and prescription drugs.

She did this well during an interview with MSNBC’s “Morning Joe” on Tuesday. She spoke about multiple legislative wins that fall into this category, such as the CHIPS and Science Act that President Biden signed into law on Tuesday, and the PACT Act, which will expand health care for sick veterans. The speaker also glowed about the pending Inflation Reduction Act, the reconciliation package that the Senate recently passed. “It’s pretty exciting,” she said, adding, “It has an integrity to it. And yes, it is about meeting the needs of America’s working families for the people, not politics.”

Later, at a White House signing ceremony, she was once again on message: “The CHIPS and Science Act is a historic achievement — lowering kitchen table costs and creating good-paying jobs for America’s families,” she declared. “That is our first responsibility, domestically. Returning American semiconductor production to world leadership status. And unleashing America’s science and technology to maintain our leadership for the future.”

Above all else, she tells her members, Democrats should run on what they’ve done. Naturally, that will mean highlighting all the measures Republicans opposed (the $35 price cap on insulin being among the juiciest targets).

But she also says Democrats must focus on their future agenda. If Democrats can hold the House and add two more Senate seats, she said at the signing ceremony, “we can get much more done in the United States Senate for the Voting Rights Act and voting protections, and the list goes on — a woman’s right to choose and the rest.”

Since the Supreme Court overruled federal protection of abortion rights, she and scores of Democrats have elevated the issue to the top of their agendas. For Democrats such as Rep. Elaine Luria (Va.), abortion now figures heavily in their ads:

Rep. Kim Schrier (Wash.) has been running a similar ad:

Even in red states such as Kansas and Nebraska, Democrats are leaning into the “cultural” issue. They have discovered that talking about reproductive rights — such as women’s freedom from forced pregnancy and birth, access to post-miscarriage care and privacy protections — works when facing a party seeking absolute bans across the country.

Ironically, Democratic candidates need not to do much on their third issue: Republicans’ lawlessness, penchant for violence and hostility toward law enforcement. When asked on NBC News’s “Today Show” about House Minority Leader Kevin McCarthy’s hysterical reaction to the news that the FBI searched Trump’s residence, Pelosi dismissed the Republican leader’s statement and said, “We believe in the rule of law. And that’s what our country is about. And no person is above the law. Not even the president of the United States. Not even a former president of the United States.”

Moreover, Democratic House and Senate candidates need not do much heavy lifting when it comes to the Jan. 6 insurrection, Republicans’ slavish support for the “big lie,” their refusal to hold Trump accountable and election deniers’ threats to refuse to certify opponents’ wins. They can easily drill down on the clear and present danger that Trump’s Republican supplicants pose to the country. And they can rely heavily on the report from the House Jan. 6 select committee and the megaphone that Rep. Liz Cheney (R-Wyo.) effectively uses. (If Democrats are lucky, Trump will declare his candidacy for 2024 and scare the living daylights out of the majority of the electorate that fears his return to office.)

Altogether, Democrats are ready to go on the offensive. They can tout their legislative wins and promise to fight for abortion rights. And they can do so while reminding voters that the GOP cannot be entrusted with power.

name: David Trone
subject: A win for all of us
disclaimer_text: Paid for by David Trone for Congress, Inc
body:
Peter,
Last weekend, the Senate finally moved the Inflation Reduction Act across the finish line. Tomorrow, I’ll join my colleagues in the House in passing the bill and sending it to President Biden for his signature.
Let’s be clear: this legislation is a win for all of us. And it serves as a monumental point of progress for our country.
For years, we’ve heard pleas from Marylanders to reduce the cost of prescription drugs. Too many families struggle to afford life-saving prescriptions — and pharmaceutical companies have made billions off of their backs. With this legislation, we’re finally beginning to ease the chokehold that these companies have on the American people by allowing Medicare to negotiate the price of the highest-cost drugs and capping the price of insulin for Medicare beneficiaries.
We’re addressing the existential threat that climate change poses to all of us by making historic investments in green energy, clean air, and emissions reductions. In order to combat climate change and global warming, it’s imperative that we take drastic measures right now. This legislation is a step in the right direction of moving toward a greener economy and incentivizing families and businesses to make climate-friendly choices.
The good news is that this bill pays for itself through reforms to our tax system that make corporations pay more of their fair share. We’ll increase corporate tax revenues by over $300 billion and empower the IRS to hold wealthy individuals accountable and ensure they aren’t dodging their tax obligations. With this investment in the IRS alone, we’ll decrease the national deficit by over $200 billion over the next decade.
But the truth is, this bill doesn’t do nearly enough to move us forward. Senate Republicans got in the way of our progress.
Because of them, millions of Americans who aren’t on Medicare will continue to face astronomical prescription prices — making it difficult to obtain life-saving medication. We’ll continue to fall short of the environmental protection that we so desperately need. And businesses and the wealthiest Americans will still benefit from a tax system designed to work in their favor, using loopholes like carried interest to get ahead of working Americans.
We have the opportunity to stop this. And it’s coming up in November.
It’s crucial that we expand our majorities in the House and the Senate this election. We can’t continue to try to solve our biggest challenges with piecemeal approaches and slow progress.
So while we celebrate this progress, let’s make it possible to achieve even more. Let’s mobilize now to get out the vote this year and elect leaders who will work with us, not against us. We have less than 3 months to get it done. Are you in?
Sincerely,
David

Now the real fight begins
Friends,
I wanted to send a quick thank you note for helping to push my good friend Brad over the finish line in Tuesday’s primary. I always had faith that he’d pull it off, but we can never take a single vote for granted. So now that it’s official, from the bottom of my heart: THANK YOU!
Because of the generosity and commitment of supporters like you, Democrats of Wisconsin’s Third District have nominated a hardworking, courageous, and compassionate nominee to replace me in Congress. Brad has the leadership and fortitude to tackle the challenges our state and our country are facing in this critical time. I couldn’t be more thrilled to see him advance to the general election.
_But now, the real fight begins_.
Brad’s insurrectionist opponent ran unopposed in the GOP primary, so he’s been able to amass a huge war chest solely for the general election – and he’s not wasting any time.**He and his big money donors have ALREADY hit the airwaves to try and set the narrative of this race on their terms**.
That’s why Brad needs your help to fight back and get his message out. We need to replenish his campaign funds after an expensive final few weeks of the primary and stop his insurrectionist opponent from dominating the narrative. Hi folks,
I just wanted to take a little time to touch base with you, some of my top supporters. And time is exactly what I want to talk to you about—because with the election just around the corner, we can’t afford to waste a single minute.

**James Judge, Republican Party win Tampa Bay Chamber straw poll for Florida’s 14th Congressional District**
_Judge remains the Republican favorite in Florida’s 14th Congressional District primary by winning the straw poll among Republicans, and the total number of Republican votes was higher than that of Democrats._ TAMPA, Fla. – The Republican frontrunner in Florida’s 14th Congressional District, James Judge, won a straw poll conducted by the Tampa Bay Chamber of Commerce on Wednesday by a decisive margin.Judge won 72 out of 123 votes (58.53%) of the Republican votes. Two other Republican candidates, including one whose votes may not even count on election day, split the rest of the vote among the party.Furthermore, the straw poll was conducted among Republicans, Democrats and Independents, and showed that overall, Republicans garnered more support than Democrats. Only 109 respondents chose a Democrat – incumbent Kathy Castor or her primary challenger Christopher Bradley – while 123 total votes were cast for the Republican candidates. That means Republicans received 53% of the vote, and Democrats only 47%.Judge was grateful for the support and applauded the outcome.“Kathy Castor is nervous, and she absolutely should be,” Judge said. “She’s ramped up her campaign efforts for the first time in years, because she knows that she and her Democrat colleagues in Congress have earned their future removal from office, which is coming this November.”“I’m not surprised by this poll result at all,” said Judge. “Americans are rightfully fed up with sky-high inflation, rising costs of fuel and food, massive debt and other Democrat policies that Kathy Castor and her friends have supported. They have made life undeniably more difficult for Americans over the past two years, and when the votes are counted in November, I think they’ll come out in our favor.”The straw poll is another positive sign for Judge, as his campaign continues to gain momentum with less than two weeks remaining before the primary election.Judge recently earned the recommendation of the Tampa Bay Times, and has been endorsed by legendary Republican strategist Roger Stone, Congressman Paul Gosar (R-AZ), retired Republican Congressman Ted Yoho, Pinellas County Sheriff Bob Gualtieri, The Tampa Police Benevolent Association, Clearwater Mayor Frank Hibbard, the Community Patriots Tampa, Chris Chambers, a former Congressional candidate and community leader, and former SBA White House Deputy Chief Matt Becker, who previously ran for Congress against an incumbent Democrat in St. Petersburg.**About James Judge:
** Judge, who publicly announced his run for Congress earlier this year, is the only Tampa Bay area native running in the race, having been born in Clearwater, Florida. Judge graduated from Eckerd College in St. Petersburg and served in the U.S. Coast Guard in Operation Iraqi Freedom. Additionally, he served in Kabul, Afghanistan as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2010 until 2011. He now owns Judge Public Relations, a Tampa-based PR firm and marketing agency with clients worldwide.Judge is married to his wife Danielle, who is also a small business owner in Hillsborough County. The Judges are avid animal lovers and together, they have four dogs, three cats, two horses and 10 chickens. Judge is a proud member of the NRA, Coastal Conservation Association, Veterans of Foreign Wars and the American Legion. The Judges are also active members at Idlewild Baptist Church in Tampa.

#
We noticed a concerning trend in our online fundraising, Peter.
Pramila relies on small-dollar donations from our grassroots supporters. She doesn’t take a dime from the corporate PACs that have massive influence in Congress. So, it’s significant that we saw a 19% decrease in online fundraising last quarter. **And we’ve seen a steep dip in fundraising at the beginning of this month, too.**
During a midterm election year when Pramila is running for re-election and we’re fighting to protect the Democratic majority in the House, we cannot see our fundraising numbers continue to drop. [**Can you donate $3 today to help us turn our fundraising around?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/15712?refcode=em20220811-1508&t=1&akid=1508%2E420207%2ErWO4JY)

Team Jayapal

| |

| Peter,
High profile resignations have rocked Cook County State’s Attorney Kim Foxx’s office. Over 235 people have resigned from Foxx’s office in the past year, according to the Chicago Tribune. **[NBC-5 reported](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=0acabdd1cb&e=7dd0b93d07)** that 5 people have now resigned from Cook County State's Attorney Kim Foxx’s office in recent days.

The most high-profile resignation was that of 25-year veteran assistant state's attorney James Murphy, who left saying “I can no longer work for this Administration. I have zero confidence in their leadership...”
---
|
---
| Increased crime throughout Cook County and a rush for the door in Foxx’s office are all the result of the same thing: Leadership in the State’s Attorney’s Office. Kim Foxx is the problem.

We see the same failed leadership in cities across the country where woke prosecutors push anti-police, anti-law-and-order schemes using feel-good language like “re-imagining prosecution,” and argue that “data and science” back their pro-criminal, anti-victim approach. It’s garbage.

Under my leadership, the Orland Park Village Board called for Kim Foxx’s resignation. This week, I renewed that demand: Kim Foxx needs to resign.

Unfortunately, far-Left Democrats like Sean Casten continue to protect her and defend her disastrous ideology. Casten even co-sponsored the George Floyd Act that would have made Kim Foxx’s governance the model for the nation.

Now, Cook County is in big trouble - and it makes up over half of the new 6th district. He may want to look the other way, but that just isn’t leadership. He needs to put politics aside and disavow Foxx and the ideology that has led to out of control crime. He needs to stop protecting Kim Foxx and call for her resignation. Cook County families and businesses should be able to expect their government - at a minimum - to provide public safety.

It’s just common sense: Enforce the law. Support law enforcement. That’s what we do in Orland Park. The results speak for themselves. We’ve seen the lowest index crimes in 27 years, while Cook County as a whole saw massive increases in crime. I am running to bring the same common sense leadership to Congress and to restore safety to our streets.
Thank you,

Keith Pekau
_Mayor of Orland Park
Republican Nominee for Illinois’ Sixth Congressional District_
---
|
---
| _**In Case You Missed It**_
**Nancy Pelosi Throws Millions Behind Sean Casten**

“Pelosi and Casten are part of the gang in Washington DC that drove inflation rates to 9.1%, caused gas to skyrocket to nearly $6 per gallon in Cook and DuPage Counties, pushed anti-police policies and rhetoric that has led to soaring crime rates, and stoked deeply bitter partisan divides nationwide.

“If voters want to continue down that path, Sean Casten – Nancy Pelosi’s hand-picked candidate – is their guy. But the people I talk to everyday on the campaign trail are ready to bring common-sense back to Washington. As mayor of Orland Park, I’ve reduced crime, reined in spending, and cut property tax rates. I am going to Congress to lead with common sense, put people over politics, and end the Pelosi-Casten era of out of control government.”

---
| **Casten Promised to Protect SALT Deductions. He Didn’t.**

“Seems like Casten is for your family and business right up until they get in the way of big government deals for his family and their business. I am sick of self-dealers in Washington putting themselves ahead of the people they are supposed to represent. As mayor of Orland Park, I’ve put people over politics to reduce spending, reduce tax rates and improve accountability. I am going to Congress to do the same thing.”

**[Read the whole story here.](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=e04e92d4eb&e=7dd0b93d07)**
---
|
---
|
# **_Connecting the Dots_**
---
|
# **Too Soon.**

The White House spent much of the last week touting gas prices, which have fallen modestly for the better part of two months after serving as a thorn in the side of the Biden administration for nearly a full year.

**From Keith:**_Democrats are celebrating that the price of a gallon of gas is only $4.33. The price of a gallon of gas was $2.54 when Joe Biden took office. The fact that Democrats are celebrating gas prices increasing nearly $2 per gallon under their leadership shows how out of touch they are with families and businesses. I live, work, and serve as mayor right here in IL-06. Anything that impacts my community impacts me. That’s why I’m running for Congress – to implement solutions that help IL-06 residents._

**Remembering Tavares Davis**

Orland Park business owner Tavares Davis was shot and killed Tuesday afternoon in Dolton. **[According to a WGN report](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=d7a3c684e6&e=7dd0b93d07)** , his family said he was found with no valuables on him, no car keys, no wallet or jewelry.

He was a successful businessman in Chicago’s South Suburbs and a loving father.

The family said they are devastated and lost not just a family patriarch and doting father, but the driving force behind a successful family business.

“Whoever robbed my husband has robbed us,” Nakesha Davis said. “They robbed me of my husband and partner and they robbed my children.”

**From Keith:** _"I am very sad to hear about the shooting of Tavares Davis in Dolton. Tavares owned a business here in Orland Park that people love. But more importantly, he was a father and a husband. I want to send my deepest condolences to his family, especially his wife, Nakesha. My thoughts and prayers are with all of you.

"It is inexcusable that another Cook County family is grieving a loved one because crime is running rampant on our streets. Every day we hear another story. We urgently need to get a grip on this. For Kim Foxx to continue to release felons onto the streets as peoples' sons, fathers and husbands are being killed on a daily basis is indefensible."_

He needs to put politics aside and disavow Foxx and the ideology that has led to out of control crime. He needs to stop protecting Kim Foxx and call for her resignation. Cook County families and businesses should be able to expect their government - at a minimum - to provide public safety. It’s just common sense: Enforce the law. Support law enforcement. That’s what we do in Orland Park. The results speak for themselves. We’ve seen the lowest index crimes in 27 years, while Cook County as a whole saw massive increases in crime. Fellow Conservative, we did it!!

**_I’m humbled and honored to be the Republican nominee for the United States Senate from Connecticut!_**.

body:

Greetings, Supporters!

What an election! So many of my supporters have asked what Tuesday's results were, and the truth is - we don't know yet. I have not conceded the race because the difference is a matter of 73 votes... which calculates to 0.167%. It is just too close to call!

That being said, I need your help! Each county will canvas the election in the coming days, and we need observers. Come be a part of your election process! You can join your county as well as the others if you are interested, and we are asking that you do. We have listed times and locations below:

* Dane - Friday, August 12th at 9:00 am [https://zoom.us/j/93307880802](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001YvUJ5uE5gjczfy1Q2SnNQqNHcl3f6Fw_ehr2IQCB3kw-0MtOfc_G0Q4TVXYb8WM4DmNsEXJ4xafq2hjcSjeMTdAj3V0RxaWsMKuDMH7T-Bvmo9Yw4ci_c00jGOtC6SMfWV_PzrRu08R0QiQm8DQRUqa-uCsHQMo3&c=5hnBc9K_kuXYkR6qTZsdBwxGVla5BGSfIesQhoHe9x8rFUcdAkyZXg==&ch=0gltwl5oOdJb8lqriU0xhBkgNd20aTr8hhjjTRwaL8wDjNTGUwbl9g==) Meeting ID: 933 0788 0802
* Sauk - Monday, August 15th at 9:00 am - Sauk County West Square Building, Room # 140, 505 Broadway, Baraboo
* Iowa - Monday, August 15th at 9:30 am - Iowa County Courthouse, Upper Level - Loft Room 222 N. Iowa Street Dodgeville
* Rock - Monday, August 15th at 9:00 am - Rock County Courthouse 2nd floor conference room, 51 S Main St, Janesville
* Green - Tuesday, August 16th at 9:00 am - Green County Courthouse conf room next to Clerk's office 51 S Main St., Janesville
* Lafayette - Tuesday, August 16th at 9:00 am - Lafayette County Courthouse, Rm 202 626 Main Street, Darlington

Please reply to this email to let us know if you will be attending any of the canvasses. We need to know in advance.

Thank you so much! And please know that no matter what the outcome of the election ends up being, I will not stop fighting for the people of my district!

Your continued thoughts, prayers, and support are greatly appreciated!

Thank you!
| Charity Barry

Friend,

**On Sunday, the U.S. Senate officially passed the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022, a bill that will combat the climate crisis, lower health care costs, and make corporations pay their fair share.**

With Vice President Kamala Harris’ tie-breaking vote, this legislation passed by a margin of 51–50. Every single Senate Republican voted against the bill, siding with corporate interests. Thanks to the work from activists like you, Senate Democrats are making history and delivering for working families and younger generations.

**Here’s what the Inflation Reduction Act will do once signed into law:**
* Make the largest investment in climate action in U.S. history;
* Put our nation on track to cut 40% of greenhouse gas emissions by 2030;
* Create 9 million good-paying clean energy jobs;
* Reduce energy bills for working families across the country;
* Lower health care premiums and prescription drug costs for million of Americans;
* Ensure the wealthiest corporations pay their fair share

[Write to your member of Congress and urge them to pass the Inflation Reduction Act without delay!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49107403/360842199/1811116934?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZjY5ODM3MS1jMjE5LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_BMe2lBXDvIVXq5pU8r0GKIOXApkWsfGJJpZLTMGh2A=&emci=7220236a-c219-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=7f698371-c219-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=6787172)

For years, we have been fighting for our government to take action in securing a healthy, habitable planet and find a solution to help boost our economy that will positively impact our generation and generations to come. Thanks to you speaking out and contacting Congress, together we were able to make this moment happen.

I have looked into the eyes of many of our officers around the country as they describe the daily stress and trauma they experience. Despite being understaffed and underfunded, they still work so hard to keep our streets and communities safe. This week, _An America United_ released a national 4-point proposal to combat crime and support our women and men in law enforcement. These common sense proposals include:
---
1. 1. _**Re-funding the Police**_
2. _**Holding Violent Criminals Accountable **_
3. _**Combating the Opioid Crisis**_
4. _**Securing our Border**_

---
We can't stand idly by and watch criminals run rampant while our brave police officers are understaffed and unsupported. 👉 Today, I am asking for your help to support _An America United_ in funding the national release of this 4-point plan. $10 or anything you can give will help deliver this across the country and persuade our elected officials to follow our lead. | | Tomorrow, I will vote for the Inflation Reduction Act and send it to President Biden for his signature. This bill will be a significant investment in our efforts to combat climate change, make health care more affordable, reduce the cost of living, and shrink the deficit. These climate investments are what I am most excited about:
* $369 billion to reduce greenhouse gas emissions by 40% by 2030, a huge step toward net-zero carbon emissions by 2050.
* Money to restore and preserve coastal habitats around Puget Sound and other coastlines.
* Investments in electric postal service vehicles.
* Funds to reduce air pollution in Washington ports.

In addition, under the Inflation Reduction Act:
* Medicare will be allowed to negotiate prescription drug prices.
* Starting in 2025, out-of-pocket costs for prescription drugs will be capped at $2000 per year (and insulin at $35/month) for seniors on Medicare.
* A minimum tax of 15% for billion-dollar corporations to ensure they pay their fair share
* $300 billion in deficit reduction.

**This is what Democrats do — deliver for the American people.** We do not bury our heads in the sand and hope that problems will disappear on their own. Instead, we get to work and find solutions. Whether you are a senior making the painful choice between food or prescriptions, or a working parent alarmed at what you are paying at the pump, the Inflation Reduction Act will lower your cost of living. Medicare will be newly empowered to negotiate prescription drug prices, and drug costs will be capped at $2000 a month for seniors on Medicare. Households are expected to see a drop in home heating prices and costs for all sorts of goods will drop as the price of oil comes down. **There is still much work to be done. Workers still need a raise, and we can do _even more_ to combat climate change. If the MAGA Republicans take over Congress, then we can kiss all this progress goodbye.** That is why I am going all in this election to build a grassroots campaign and keep our momentum going. | | Insurrection enablers just won big in Michigan’s GOP primary – here’s a glimpse at just some of the dangerous candidates now on the ballot:
* **Trump-endorsed Angela Rigas** attended the Jan 6th insurrection and said she considered it a compliment to be called an insurrectionist and terrorist.
* **Trump-endorsed Rep. Matt Maddock** also attended and led efforts in Michigan to overturn election results.

body:
I want to take a minute to explain why your contribution is so important to our campaign.
#

Friends —
When it comes to emails, I’m probably a lot like you: Every day I get messages like this from campaigns asking for my support.
I understand it might be hard to see how one contribution could make a difference to a campaign like ours. That’s why I want to take a minute to explain why your $3 is so important today.
Just last week, we learned who our opponent is. Trump calls him “hardcore-MAGA.” Tucker Carlson called him his “favorite candidate.” And that means the MAGA Right will be doing everything they can to mobilize behind him.
National Republicans have already spent millions attacking me to help him win. Worse still, he’s backed by a big tech billionaire who has spent $15 million to unseat me. Simply put, we’re in for a tough fight — and that’s why your support is so critical right now.
When you make your first $3 contribution, that money will immediately be put to work to reach voters across Arizona.
Whether it’s running television ads, sending mailers, or getting out in the field to knock doors, we can’t meet voters where they are without grassroots supporters like you who fuel our campaign.
So, I have to ask:
[**Can you please make your first $3 contribution to my re-election? We need your help to stay on track and defend this seat.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-aug22.Iyxc-M&refcode=em220811-1-15&t=1&akid=3522%2E6688874%2E8pPXCX)

I’m glad to have you on my team.
Mark Kelly

| Working families shouldn’t have to shoulder the cost of rising inflation. That’s why Sara is working tirelessly to relieve the burden of rising costs by investing in our communities and expanding access to child care.

In this year’s government funding bills, Sara secured funding for 14 local projects that will support families in San Diego. These projects will address the shortage of reliable child care for military families, establish a pilot program to support San Diego municipal employees to afford child care, invest in community health services, provide extracurricular and career advancement opportunities for local high schoolers, and more.

We're coming up on the halfway mark of our 49-day, more than 5,600 mile
Drive for Texas, which is taking Beto back to more than 65 counties for
over 75 events this summer.

We’re going to share a few highlights from our first 24 days on the road
in a moment, but first, we want to ask: [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220811-2.H4lbTY&refcode=ema20220811-202650&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=202650%2E444211%2EJoAk46 ]Will you chip in

gubernatorial candidate to visit the community since the 1960s! That’s
where we met some incredible folks like Natalia who has been going door to
door in Spanish and English to register voters in her community. This is
the exact kind of organizing and dedication that's going to ensure we have
the votes to defeat Greg Abbott.

crowd." Can you spot Beto?

body:
89 days from today is Election Day. And I cannot emphasize enough how important it is that you are engaged with our efforts to flip the House. The nex 90 days from today is Election Day. And I cannot emphasize enough how important it is that you are engaged with our efforts to flip the House. The next three months are going to be some of the most important we will have lived through in a long time.

|
Peter,

The Democrats spent four years trying to stop President Trump from getting anything accomplished for the American people. They spied on his campaign with altered evidence back in 2016 and 2017. They impeached him once. They impeached him a second time. And now they've got the January 6th Committee going full tilt against him, trying to keep him from running for office in 2024.

**The only way to protect President Trump and ourselves from the Democrats is by electing a MAGA majority.**

Today is an important date on the 2022 election calendar: **89 days from today is November 8th, aka Election Day**. We only get one shot at taking back the House and we cannot blow it. | | Peter, Remember back in the 1990s when the "peak oil" theory had people worried that we'd eventually run out of fossil fuels? Well, we've realized that**the real problem isn't running out of oil – it's running out of room in our atmosphere to put the fossil fuel emissions that are causing climate change, and running out of time to make a transition to a clean energy economy.** It's also no secret that relying on fossil fuels leaves us vulnerable to price shocks caused by global crises like Russia's war against Ukraine **–** or global supply issues like the ones caused by the pandemic that are still causing problems across many industries **–** or price gouging by oil companies and OPEC. We're already seeing what happens when the supply of oil can't keep up with demand. As the price of oil goes up, so do gas prices. Then, the cost of everything that relies on gas goes up. That means grocery prices rise as they become more expensive to farm and ship. That means heating our homes gets more expensive. **Here's the truth, Peter: an economy that relies on the price of a barrel of oil is both unstable and catastrophic for the environment.** And the best way to avoid this economic disaster _and_ solve the climate crisis is with a new generation of green jobs. As Labor Commissioner, I've worked hard to expand apprenticeship opportunities in our state to ensure that our economy has the highly skilled workforce we need **–** and to ensure that Oregonians can "earn while they learn" and get trained for a career that will provide them with good wages and benefits. Addressing the climate crisis is going to require significant investments in infrastructure, in modernizing our electric grid, and in building the renewable energy projects that are the future of how we generate electricity in this country. **And that takes a skilled workforce, and will create tens of thousands of good, union jobs in communities across Oregon, from the coast to the valley to the high desert.** If we get this right **– **and we must get this right **–** the transition to a clean energy future will result in a 21st century workforce that's economically prosperous and environmentally conscious. This green future is only possible if we elect leaders who understand what's at stake, who are willing to fight for clean energy investments and bold action on climate, and who know how critical a skilled workforce is to all of this. My name is Harriet Hageman and, unlike Liz Cheney – who lives in Northern Virginia – Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his radical Democrats hate – they run absolutely counter to the elitist values of Cheney and her establishment backers.

Unfortunately, it's those establishment backers – including Never-Trumpers at the Lincoln Project and NeoCons like John Bolton and John Boehner – who are now going all-in to keep Cheney in power.

Case in point, just a few weeks ago, Cheney held a ritzy fundraiser with Mitt Romney where she charged $10,000 a head for VIPs . . .

_On top of the nearly $5 million in campaign cash she's amassed from a steady stream of Never-Trumpers and Democrats!_

That's right – even the billionaire cousin of Far-Left Illinois Governor JB Pritzker shelled out $20,000 for Cheney!

**My friend, with the Never-Trump arm of the establishment working night and day to keep Cheney in power, I'm going to need patriots like you to keep my campaign to defeat her going.**

[**So please, won't you give an emergency $35, $50, $75, or $100 donation to my campaign so I can go dollar for dollar with her elitist backers?**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=518102dc628d40028013aac992143a18&_e=vgVVBbVrj6kWceXx1D6GxVrkCShlvYmECJjaNpBC9Xu9yXhPZNN5Av5--y86CzqCPmV3YRd7XsY4vD9hS1nCB0UI3Ek-vAoIxQkRkENmpkyhM_VNKbUV26KCdaNQfPqwUOKsP4mF7Z4wBVVXm5HeQiiRXRSGdrOqYDzLtGwVyFWi5GCqkASRREvzZStISE_NFVGCU5GGaCag7gQ5_jbFxdN1blmikSu9z0jmEka-wJbjS0Iis_5DXmCFQKU24Kkt9elRQqZpiT_setHUxVSWJaxbdui3P_J8n0lNbG3b-UnPNBURoDlATDHRBCEX7hvAX0vEAa9be8Gfdy1oPhzc_7Wr7SXkuyZ6qaOkgmCKxsV3lxkicUARHpma7l_310L2qBuwXiTUjw8wC4Du1qcbbWUUgsaIoEINHJqbp6kOB3FNVXGUGZS8T5sAxURUUiHEKHEMg6-5YVUBOiWM-LOldrI4biDH_GDkV8qA81jqYyc%3D)

It's unfortunately not hard to see why Democrats are teaming up with the establishment in taking Cheney's side.

Even before she voted to impeach President Trump on bogus charges in a sham hearing, she'd made it clear she sided with Big Government over _you_.

Sure, she loves to go around appearing on CNN and _60 Minutes_ lecturing us about how "principled" she is, but there's nothing principled about betraying the 70% of Wyoming voters who voted for President Trump.

Nor is it "principled" to sit side-by-side with Nancy Pelosi in a Soviet-Style hearing that uses Big Government to punish conservatives as political prisoners!

My friend, there are dozens of issues Liz Cheney could be tackling instead of this sham January 6th commission.

She could be investigating Afghanistan and Joe Biden's incompetence.

She could be looking into Nancy Pelosi's spying on conservative representatives.

She could be questioning Dr. Fauci's dangerous Gain-of-Function research.

**But instead, she's scoring compliments from far-left anchors at CNN in her never-ending vendetta against President Trump and his supporters!**

[**There's no room in Wyoming, or the republican party for rabid anti-Trumpers who will sell out the constituents they represent for some positive press time from fake news stations like CNN, and I hope you'll help me.**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=518102dc628d40028013aac992143a18&_e=vgVVBbVrj6kWceXx1D6GxVrkCShlvYmECJjaNpBC9Xu9yXhPZNN5Av5--y86CzqCPmV3YRd7XsY4vD9hS1nCB0UI3Ek-vAoIxQkRkENmpkyhM_VNKbUV26KCdaNQfPqwUOKsP4mF7Z4wBVVXm5HeQiiRXRSGdrOqYDzLtGwVyFWi5GCqkASRREvzZStISE_NFVGCU5GGaCag7gQ5_jbFxdN1blmikSu9z0jmEka-wJbjS0Iis_5DXmCFQKU24KkttCUk_o0KHcPs_iIvyU0Xpwgfk2czfeX7L_Vu6i5qRhUMlS0wMuJLNgfudcMB7zkbvJsR-ktF3WWa9BQBx9mOkHU4iDsKBBenNKUvX67dw669Au7z8vtKw9-dkVyoDDQmG30kA6eKHK4unow1sCq5A6L5TpekZGEMhPzbhWL60fWhW_GPXCeJZAIHQWTys-zIzUavZwYw3djs6QV1LXqagPG50PUwnjwpXPF-GfFFaTM%3D)

As I said, loyalty and freedom still mean something here in Wyoming. While DC might be full of back-door deals and shifting political winds, the men and women of my state value the Cowboy ethos and ethic of riding for the brand.

You see, back in the old West, Cowboys gave their promise to stay loyal to the people who hired them. To the people who paid them.

They made a choice to fight for the brand as it was one of their own, to keep their word to the brand, and to never betray it.

As a DC insider, Liz Cheney knows nothing about that, but I do.

My family put down roots on a ranch outside of Laramie 1879, where we've raised cattle ever since.

Out here, we have a strong work ethic and fierce independence, and we don't take kindly to Big Government Socialists like Nancy Pelosi trying to control us.

It's why I've spent my professional life as a lawyer battling Big Government and federal agencies trying to usurp our rights, and why I'll do it in Washington, too.

I'm also:
* 100% Pro-Life
* A strong supporter of our Second Amendment
* Totally and Completely Against Vaccine Mandates
* Believe in the need to fight for our Election Integrity
* A believer in our fight for election integrity
* Committed to government transparency and ending wasteful spending!

With each passing day more and more Democrats flock to her side, desperate to keep their war on President Trump and you going.

My friend, I started by telling you how, out here in my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

subject: Why the House needs to pass the Inflation Reduction Act tomorrow
disclaimer_text: Paid for and Approved by Catherine for Congress
body:
The Inflation Reduction Act Must Pass Tomorrow
Tomorrow, Friday August 12, is the day one of the most significant pieces of legislation of our lifetime will go before the House of Representatives for passage into law. The Inflation Reduction Act is much more than its name and goes far beyond addressing our current, urgent need to combat the inflation caused by a confluence of factors beyond our control.
The Inflation Reduction Act of 2022 will:
*
Make
a
historic
down
payment
on
deficit
reduction
to
fight
inflation
*
Invest
in
domestic
energy
production
and
manufacturing
*
Reduce
carbon
emissions
by
roughly
40
percent
by
2030.
*
Finally
allow
Medicare
to
negotiate
for
prescription
drug
prices
and
extend
the
expanded
Affordable
Care
Act
program
for
three
years,
through
2025.
And the bill goes even further, calling for comprehensive permitting reform legislation to be passed before the end of the fiscal year. Permitting reform is essential to unlocking domestic energy and transmission projects, which will
lower costs for consumers and help us meet our long-term emissions goals.
The bill is expected to pass along partisan lines tomorrow, and fortunately, right now we have enough Democrats in the House to make this historic bill a reality. If Catherine were in Congress today, you could be assured there would be no doubt her vote on this bill would be a loud and resounding YES [https://youtu.be/H4mgY-gmxJI?t=477] !
Unlike our current Representative, Mr Bowman, Catherine would have voted:
*
YES
on
Infrastructure
to
bring
the
funding
our
district
needs
to
combat
the
continued
flooding
that
destroys
lives
and
drains
our
resources
*
YES
on
aid
to
Ukraine
*
YES
to
funding
our
Capitol
Police
after
their
bravery
and
sacrifice
during
the
January
6,
2021
insurrection
*
YES
on
the
Abraham
Accords
to
strengthen
security
for
Israel,
our
only
truly
democratic
ally
in
the
Middle
East.
When elected to Congress, you can count on Catherine's promise that the interests of her constituents will always come first. Her votes will not be political moves to score points with The Squad. They will always support our district, its residents and our futures.
To make this happen, Catherine needs YOUR help in the next two weeks as a volunteer [https://www.mobilize.us/catherineforcongress/] and donor [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/catherineforcongress] .

Greetings, Supporters!

What an election! So many of my supporters have asked what Tuesday's results were, and the truth is - we don't know yet. I have not conceded the race because the difference is a matter of 73 votes... which calculates to 0.167%. It is just too close to call!

That being said, I need your help! Each county will canvas the election in the coming days, and we need observers. Come be a part of your election process! You can join your county as well as the others if you are interested, and we are asking that you do. We have listed times and locations below:

* Dane - Friday, August 12th at 9:00 am [https://zoom.us/j/93307880802](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0013YZ6db2jvLwkGyJ7Agk7-JwXVsIcZHvaDefoWGGBTbRzVf2HsS99UpP-iFMewp0lWrMyHL-U63MZ0us_5nq3LPtYEeB1sSaVHGOadgaHvC4MSA9_vdzDDju6gVYZQVG8sJsipjGi_JuwRsU-ZiZbyoTuSyHm1OrI&c=Bn-pzg3BY6594P21TKQYh8zVFAdGxKiE5B38OLXphGjZck9LrPJLGQ==&ch=hBx-IfXxcokDLX5sHpuWuJo31GxWyH9kO_8-yRQ_7j39zyASmxJXgQ==) Meeting ID: 933 0788 0802
* Sauk - Monday, August 15th at 9:00 am - Sauk County West Square Building, Room # 140, 505 Broadway, Baraboo

* Rock - Monday, August 15th at 9:00 am - Rock County Courthouse 2nd floor conference room, 51 S Main St, Janesville
* Green - Tuesday, August 16th at 9:00 am - Green County Courthouse conf room next to County Clerk's office, 1016 16th Avenue, Monroe
* Lafayette - Tuesday, August 16th at 9:00 am - Lafayette County Courthouse, Rm 202 626 Main Street, Darlington

Please reply to this email to let us know if you will be attending any of the canvasses. We need to know in advance.

Thank you so much! And please know that no matter what the outcome of the election ends up being, I will not stop fighting for the people of my district!

Your continued thoughts, prayers, and support are greatly appreciated!

Thank you!
| Charity Barry

name: Jane Kleeb
subject: Take Action: our communities are not collateral damage
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY OUR REVOLUTION
body:
| Peter Willis,

Joe Manchin wants to fast-track new gas, oil, and carbon pipelines by removing environmental reviews that keep our communities safe. Manchin was promised last week he would get a vote on this fast-track bill in exchange for his support on the IRA bill in Congress.

Our communities are not collateral damage. Our communities are not bargaining chips.

[Can we count on you to contact your House Representative to tell them our demands?](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6271?t=11&akid=3243%2E5885482%2E_8b_Od)

**No fast-tracking new gas or oil projects
No fast-tracking carbon pipelines
No cutting environmental safeguards in any fossil fuel projects
Separate the fast-track vote from the resolution to fund the government **
| | [Find Your Rep](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6271?t=12&akid=3243%2E5885482%2E_8b_Od)
---

All over the world, people are suffering record-high temperatures that will continue to rise.

As wildfires rage across the west coast, coal, gas, and oil companies are trying to get Congress to cut more regulations and rush forward with new carbon extraction projects and ease permitting requirements, which could weaken a critical environmental protection law that requires federal agencies to scrutinize the impacts of major infrastructure projects. Black, Latino and Indigenous communities have frequently used the law to contest projects that could have harmed their neighborhoods.

In the Midwest, communities are being threatened with eminent domain to take their land for risky carbon pipelines that will threaten people’s lives. It is insanity for our leaders to even consider dropping fossil fuel safeguards while hailing a historic climate bill.

Leadership has committed to giving fossil fuel companies what they want in their deal with Manchin and other corporate Democrats. **Shockingly, it appears the language that is to be included in the resolution to fund the government was written by the American Petroleum Institute, the lobbying arm of the fossil fuel industry.** When the House returns this Friday to vote on the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA), they need to hear from thousands of people. That’s where we all come in.

[Will you take 2 minutes to call your House Rep today and stop the Manchin deal that blocks our progress on Climate Change>>>](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6271?t=13&akid=3243%2E5885482%2E_8b_Od)

| [Find Your Rep](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6271?t=14&akid=3243%2E5885482%2E_8b_Od)
---

If Manchin gets his way, new fossil fuel pipelines will wipe out many of the gains we’ve made in the existing IRA. We cannot let a side deal with literal coal barons reverse our course on climate and our future.

[**Speak out now to demand an end to Fossil Fuel Fast-tracking. Collectively, we will be heard.**](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6271?t=15&akid=3243%2E5885482%2E_8b_Od)

In solidarity,

Jane Kleeb

**Our Revolution Board Member and Environmental Activist**

I’m honored to be the official Democratic nominee for Congress | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ca1eb9713785/i-am-running-for-congress-9141074?e=356c0699dd)
---
| | | [ ](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=03f81eb231&e=356c0699dd)
---
| | | Hi there,

I’m honored to be the official Democratic nominee for Congress in the 5th District, and I’m looking forward to the hard work ahead on the campaign trail.

**There’s a simple contrast between me and my opponent. I’m hard-working, middle class, open-minded, practical, and I want to solve our country’s challenges, together.** My opponent relies on special interests and Party bosses to tell him how to vote, and does all he can to avoid tough, or really any, conversations with anyone in the district.

Where he plans to win on party brand loyalty, I plan to win by earning trust and building bridges with a diverse group of people.
---
| [ ](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=65a332f6ea&e=356c0699dd)
---
| **I’ve got a lot more in common with people across southeastern Wisconsin, I’m out here listening to everybody willing to talk to me, and I’m confident they will vote for change in November.**

If you’re ready for change too, [will you join us with a donation of $50, $25 or even just $10 today?](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=b3504f9ccd&e=356c0699dd)

I don’t have millionaire and billionaire special interests in my back pocket working to steal YOUR seat in Congress for another term. What I do have are small-dollar grassroots donors who are [chipping in whatever they can because they want to feel represented again.](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=260030d7c2&e=356c0699dd)

If we are going to have a chance at firing Fitz this November, [I need your support](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=0c11ec2fe1&e=356c0699dd) as we work toward real, tangible change so that all of us have a chance at the American dream.

I’m proud to be on this journey with you.

Thank you,
Mike

We fight to win.

# _The voice of the people. We fight to win._
[Donate Now](https://americanfirebrand.cmail20.com/t/y-l-nndjiy-ihhjkhtyud-r/)
# **_NEW VIDEO _**
# **What Is A Woman? The Million-Dollar Question**
With a million dollars on the line, an unsuspecting contestant will face the hardest question the show has ever asked: what is a woman? [WATCH NOW](https://americanfirebrand.cmail20.com/t/y-l-nndjiy-ihhjkhtyud-y/) [](https://americanfirebrand.cmail20.com/t/y-l-nndjiy-ihhjkhtyud-j/)
# **_NEW VIDEO _**
# **Female-Identifying Men Dominate at Women 's Basketball Tryouts**
It's been a tough year for the girls' varsity basketball team. Luckily, their coach has an exciting new strategy to help them start winning. Bring on the new recruits! [WATCH NOW](https://americanfirebrand.cmail20.com/t/y-l-nndjiy-ihhjkhtyud-t/) [](https://americanfirebrand.cmail20.com/t/y-l-nndjiy-ihhjkhtyud-i/) **WHY WE MADE THESE** Highlighting the absurdity of woke transgender politics, American Firebrand has released two new sketch comedy videos that parody the deranged and unhinged transgender obsession of today's left. American Firebrand is a super PAC which focuses on the future of political rhetoric and motivating conservative voters.In the first video, a takeoff on the game show "Who Wants to Be a Millionaire," a contestant struggles to answer the multiple-choice question, "What is a woman?" In the second video, members of a losing women's college basketball team are horrified when their coach recruits men who "identify" as women to join the team."It would be funnier if it weren't a real problem, but humor is the best way to demonstrate the lengths to which transgender activists will go to bully Americans into participating in their lies and impose intolerable costs for telling the truth," said Paige Willey, Director of American Firebrand. "When a Supreme Court nominee refuses to define the term "woman," a biological male is nominated for female college athlete of the year, and doctors are prescribing chemical castration to children, it's time for clear-thinking Americans to stand up for what is right. We must protect women from humiliation and mistreatment, and protect children from the medical horrors of "transitioning" now commonly pushed in doctors' offices and K-12 classrooms."American Firebrand seeks to energize and motivate conservative voters with the bold, clear, and authentic political messaging they want to hear. It features top shelf multi-media capabilities and gets involved in selected federal races and pushes Republican candidates and office holders toward a message that better communicates with Republican base voters. American Firebrand falls under the umbrella of New Founding, a wide-ranging venture organization that seeks to grow an economy that is the answer to "woke" corporations currently dominating American life. New Founding includes Principal Investments, a venture capital fund which will support like-minded small- and medium-sized businesses, and ALIGN, a weekly newsletter which coaches conservative consumers on how to avoid buying from companies that hate them.
