body:
**[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=56bd7d348d0846f9aa921fc085e36a0d&_e=JpUkThN_wN9ADUZrcoMj-m238tAKejLrHjlC3J8mybtCq7g1QYr8o8ZXyAE4vw5WBgTM0h6zxg_DrzfwqVkxauCAer1NnbVSNbD5yLy6or7_baiO5HkAEg7hX9bRzM0Ey6i2lK2XvVzSsqrk0gsJ_cfxYMLWCYLCBqUJG24luqJ0B6nNwwtzMYuHld4X-EA63-4Lm5plledEaoVcEgq9NaheWnTJPOSfgOnT_HHwMYMGzjDFEiyHja4CEFfn5XxHgIiKr_le__nzN1xBcgaaunzh-F1jXlgNeR5Gqjda18pdt8Wii3XztLkPXS7mEZWP27WyarPDSxkNKOIyFEXsK6dtJIOhaBMXOBBUM0iaLtRCF8HNkHPjgfuakWSx2FzQ_0I1b3lEmIvC9rq_tH4Srw%3D%3D)**

Friend,
You've seen across the country a wave of woke prosecutors funded by out of state interests refusing to uphold the rule of law who are allowing criminals to walk free without ever facing consequences for their crimes. As Governor, I have made it clear: **In this state, we uphold the rule of law. We respect the law enforcement officers who put their lives on the line every day to keep our communities safe.**

We DO NOT allow woke activist prosecutors to abdicate their duty to do their job and protect their communities. This is why I took action to right the wrongs of a prosecutor whose conduct has fallen below the standard that is required by the Florida Constitution by refusing to enforce laws he doesn't like. A prosecutor is not a law unto himself.

**_[[UPHOLD THE RULE OF LAW]](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=56bd7d348d0846f9aa921fc085e36a0d&_e=JpUkThN_wN9ADUZrcoMj-m238tAKejLrHjlC3J8mybtCq7g1QYr8o8ZXyAE4vw5WBgTM0h6zxg_DrzfwqVkxauCAer1NnbVSNbD5yLy6or7_baiO5HkAEg7hX9bRzM0Ey6i2lK2XvVzSsqrk0gsJ_cfxYMLWCYLCBqUJG24luqJ0B6nNwwtzMYuHld4X-EA6yYMqIECVl_o1hDJELDCML-g9gdRfAysD107a1NK6PySB9K_DOz78BS1uVjaQYmwC-9V6Zouy2odqZri1rmyZlWXymSdhvg5mmS9K_m9Cbe6Fl48iIMEHmB6VoKOwud3O17gjR3CaEY2bB03Gt01j5SoP74j80UsG7XQdj17ZM5JTR8uOA9CoqqCmG-aihJM2rvv3q_Am-PQGGFZ3Fjr34g%3D%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=645171481de93327bc960403d9d6cbc7bf571d819c9300408453fabc7720711dfcdc8d6d712f8c75a5fe90ab67d379481cf2fa49bfdf629a")_**

We are not going to allow this pathogen of ignoring the law that's been going on around the country to get a foothold in the state of Florida. We are going to make sure that our laws are enforced and that no individual prosecutor puts themselves above the law.

It's simple. If you put yourself above the law, you are violating and neglecting your duty and you are displaying a lack of competence to be able to perform those duties. If you abandon the duties of your oath of office, you no longer have the right to hold that office.

The crime in places like San Francisco and Los Angeles is out of control. Police are unable to do their jobs, businesses are closing up shop, and violent criminals are walking free all because of the dereliction of duty by prosecutors who are funded by ideological activists. In Florida, we're not going to sit idly by and watch our state spiral into chaos. We're going to respect our law enforcement officers, we're going to protect our citizens, and we're going to enforce the law.

As your Governor, I will not stand for woke prosecutors, who are entrusted with enforcing the law, showing more deference and care for criminals than the victims of their crimes in the name of "social justice." Denying a victim their day in court is not justice. Allowing a criminal to walk free of consequences for their crimes is not justice. It is, in fact, the opposite of justice.

**_[[REJECT WOKE PROSECUTORS]](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=56bd7d348d0846f9aa921fc085e36a0d&_e=JpUkThN_wN9ADUZrcoMj-m238tAKejLrHjlC3J8mybtCq7g1QYr8o8ZXyAE4vw5WBgTM0h6zxg_DrzfwqVkxauCAer1NnbVSNbD5yLy6or7_baiO5HkAEg7hX9bRzM0Ey6i2lK2XvVzSsqrk0gsJ_cfxYMLWCYLCBqUJG24luqJ0B6nNwwtzMYuHld4X-EA6ucROHvn3DlGy2jdIQZyDlJczl1QDTSToOuU8l_5rEekTQBjkJSfTSy_jXgR7YLj2qcgc1oi0PBssmXU5Sybv_NOH8VK0uFnL-m2K1P8lIrn37eAdHn-YQydCETnJcy9n7B8beYCvcgA9o0kC35gkJ8CPeV_uesWJIJPlqWYpdAJRPyB7BiY-h6DW4dOhSSkzXxwWfzRB3-CtuuKPqisl9Q%3D%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=645171481de93327e26993ba67113f8689f06e8ca94ebda36bd320efd24e432ee79049f01519eca11f1dc046e8b3a44077fbaced8a682f9a")_**

Florida is a law-and-order state. I am not going to back down from that one inch. The radical Left is already attacking me for doing my job to ensure that the laws are enforced in our state. As Governor, I have made it clear: In this state, we uphold the rule of law. We respect the law enforcement officers who put their lives on the line every day to keep our communities safe. We DO NOT allow woke activist prosecutors to abdicate their duty to do their job and protect their communities. This is why I took action to right the wrongs of a prosecutor whose conduct has fallen below the standard that is required by the Florida Constitution by refusing to enforce laws he doesn't like. A prosecutor is not a law unto himself. [[UPHOLD THE RULE OF LAW]]( "") We are not going to allow this pathogen of ignoring the law that's been going on around the country to get a foothold in the state of Florida. We are going to make sure that our laws are enforced and that no individual prosecutor puts themselves above the law. It's simple. If you put yourself above the law, you are violating and neglecting your duty and you are displaying a lack of competence to be able to perform those duties. If you abandon the duties of your oath of office, you no longer have the right to hold that office. The crime in places like San Francisco and Los Angeles is out of control. Police are unable to do their jobs, businesses are closing up shop, and violent criminals are walking free all because of the dereliction of duty by prosecutors who are funded by ideological activists. In Florida, we're not going to sit idly by and watch our state spiral into chaos. We're going to respect our law enforcement officers, we're going to protect our citizens, and we're going to enforce the law. As your Governor, I will not stand for woke prosecutors, who are entrusted with enforcing the law, showing more deference and care for criminals than the victims of their crimes in the name of "social justice." clean_body: | Friend, Before we get started and I go any further, I’d just like to take a moment to thank you for your time and previous support in advance. It’s what powers our campaign to fight for hardworking Americans across the country. Look, I know it gets old with our campaign texting, emailing, and calling you nonstop, but I’d be lying if I didn’t say that your support is the LIFEBLOOD OF OUR CAMPAIGN. | I hope you know that the main reason I’m running for the U.S. Senate seat in Ohio is because I care deeply about my state, my country, and the issues that we’re facing right now. I grew up in Middletown, Ohio. Middletown was once a booming manufacturing town where Ohioans could live a middle-class life. As I got older, I realized that the jobs and economic opportunities that were once present in my hometown were fading away and it left the community around me grasping for hope. Look, I won’t sugarcoat it, my home life wasn’t all peaches and cream. I had my fair share of turbulence at home as a kid, with my dad leaving home when I was young, and my mother struggling with drug addiction her entire life. I’m so lucky that I had someone who helped me turn everything around and keep me straight. That person was my Mamaw (my grandmother). My grandmother taught me tough love, discipline, and that the world wasn’t just going to hand you what you wanted. She kept me straight and focused through her dedication to faith, family, and the hope of a better life that lay ahead (or it could’ve been the 19 handguns she owned.) You wouldn’t believe it from the photo above, but I went on to serve my nation in the Iraq War as a proud Marine, graduated from The Ohio State University, received my law degree from Yale Law School, and wrote a bestselling book. That wasn’t enough. I wanted to do more. I wanted to do more for my state and my country. That’s why when I moved back to Ohio and saw the state I love devastated by job loss, addiction, economic turmoil, and much more, I started a business in Cincinnati focused on growing companies that create well-paying jobs. I’m not done yet though, I’m running for the U.S. Senate because Ohio and America need a true conservative who’s focused on standing up to Communist China, securing our Southern Border, and looking out for the people who’ve been left behind. Because I know what that feels like. So, if you’re committed to putting America First again, if you’re committed to standing up to the Woke Left’s Socialist Agenda, and you’re focused on protecting your freedoms and conservative values, Let’s ride. It’s time to get back to work. God Bless you and your family, JD Vance Conservative Outsider. Marine. Businessman. Author. Ohio needs a true conservative in the U.S. Senate. It needs someone who understands how our economic and government leaders conspire to make life harder for normal Americans. Ohio needs JD Vance. Fellow Conservative,

It was Friday, August 21, 2015.

I boarded train #9364 in Brussels, bound for Paris. My plans were simple and spirits were high. I was on vacation with my two best friends after completing a tour in Afghanistan as a U.S. soldier.

But someone we didn’t expect boarded the train that day too, and he would change our lives forever.

Ayoub El-Khazzani, an ISIS terrorist emerged from the bathroom, bare-chested and armed with a box cutter, an assault rifle, a jar of gasoline, and 270 rounds of ammunition attempted to take over and kill more than 500 passengers.

**And he would have succeeded, except he didn’t know three proud Americans were aboard and ready to fight like hell. I tapped my friend on the shoulder and said: ‘Let’s go.’ **

As a soldier, I was trained to take out a terrorist threat - As an American, I was taught to stand up for freedom no matter where I was in the world. Which is why I, my friends and other brave travelers took the action needed to stop this terrorist.

This split-second decision prevented what witnesses contend could have become a mass slaughter. There is a reason I was able to make this split-second decision to intervene, Fellow Conservative – I have and always will be willing to give my life in the fight for freedom, in the image of true American values.

Hi friend,

I'm not sure when my team will get this note to your inbox, but I have a few minutes to spare right now – so I wanted to talk to you about the final 88 days of this campaign, starting with a quick story from when I was a little girl.
My parents, James and Elouise, weren't rich. My father worked as a janitor. My mother was a maid. Neither finished high school. But they had such a profound sense of duty to make life _better_ for me and my six brothers and sisters. They grounded the importance of education and civic responsibility into us.

As a matter of fact, my parents took their civic responsibility so seriously that they were 100% faithful to voting. Every time. In one instance, when our station wagon wouldn't start, they paid someone to drive them to the polls.

**They were so committed to voting, friend, that as a little girl, I thought it was illegal _not_ to vote!**
My mind is on my parents in these final 88 days of the election. People just like James and Elouise Butler – people who count so much on our democracy – are already casting their ballots in Florida's primary. They'll likely be thinking of their families as they tick off a box, hoping the people they send to Washington will do right by them and _commit to bettering _the lives of those they serve.
I know this because as I travel across Florida and meet so many incredible people, I hear stories that remind me of my upbringing. I hear stories that inspire me every day to _win this race_ so we can do better for Floridians and all of America. **So take this to heart straight from me, friend: I am in this race to win, and when I make it to the U.S. Senate, we’ll be able to pass a bold legislative agenda.**
My time is up, and I need to get on with my day. Before I sign off though, I've got to ask: **With polling showing me neck and neck with Marco Rubio, can you chip in a grassroots donation of $5 or whatever you can spare to help me pull ahead, win and expand our Democratic Senate majority? Enjoy the rest of your day, friend – and thanks for everything you do for this grassroots campaign.

As the son of hardworking farmworkers, I was up against all odds to become a United States Congressman.

My family lived in a small trailer in rural California. My brother and I shared a bed that in the daytime converted into a kitchen table.

Eventually, with the help of my family and my community, I went to UCLA and eventually to Harvard Medical School.

I can’t imagine where I would be without my community behind me. That’s the reason I have dedicated my life to service. First as a doctor and now as a Congressman representing Coachella Valley.

_But the GOP is working overtime to unseat me._

clean_body: | | | Team Ruiz hopes that you and your family are safe and healthy. Public health across the country is our top concern during this unprecedented time. To view the most up to date CDC COVID-19 safety recommendations, And if you have a moment, please read our message below. As the son of hardworking farmworkers, I was up against all odds to become a United States Congressman. My family lived in a small trailer in rural California. My brother and I shared a bed that in the daytime converted into a kitchen table. Eventually, with the help of my family and my community, I went to UCLA and eventually to Harvard Medical School. I can’t imagine where I would be without my community behind me. That’s the reason I have dedicated my life to service. First as a doctor and now as a Congressman representing Coachella Valley. But the GOP is working overtime to unseat me. | | | | | | | Republicans put tax cuts for the 1% above education and health care. A kid without a strong public school to attend or adequate health care is being set up to fail. We have an obligation to fight for every single child in this country. | | | | | | Sincerely hoping I can count on you. \-- Dr. Raul Ruiz | PO Box 3433 Palm Desert, CA 92261 PAID FOR BY DR. Peter,
You've seen across the country a wave of woke prosecutors funded by out of state interests refusing to uphold the rule of law who are allowing criminals to walk free without ever facing consequences for their crimes. As Governor, I have made it clear: **In this state, we uphold the rule of law. We respect the law enforcement officers who put their lives on the line every day to keep our communities safe.**

We DO NOT allow woke activist prosecutors to abdicate their duty to do their job and protect their communities. This is why I took action to right the wrongs of a prosecutor whose conduct has fallen below the standard that is required by the Florida Constitution by refusing to enforce laws he doesn't like. A prosecutor is not a law unto himself.

**_[[UPHOLD THE RULE OF LAW]](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=986334b1f3c4484a850ee00480884834&_e=I67K1kh6KxDydmQQEuQWAJhqv1SarvJHy_JreW_bNM4ssgdLsEtD190Vd6ADPLcX4y8YJQfT-F_pxbJm-qlYBZEMqrhArd5lEPzFnbQG-_ybR-yqJTFRMj7HVDS5WGHXpS9H-zpPptr4mM6NsgvUw3eS3cXxhSp8WtcHaIgc8PvEpj99Sm7JmusyuxRbwduf5ASquJn4BtSJKNZIkJNJwSYKFhXeMo7NYJO_M5450Mjk5_0GEQfc1Em5iX3vHMstX9exRzsSgmEO-MpysiBedwjN69BdLGT19fh4hajPQ6fEMkEAPVgjFhcNLCfbAGEDAmRiCiQ_hYP91GHEGKkB17ljY6s9hdXBZuRsvdGS2IG-OhozsdK4--u9zCWqKNVUPy_lFTVYqUEQHwEjeNx0Dw%3D%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=645171481de93327bc960403d9d6cbc7bf571d819c9300408453fabc7720711dfcdc8d6d712f8c75a5fe90ab67d379481cf2fa49bfdf629a")_**

We are not going to allow this pathogen of ignoring the law that's been going on around the country to get a foothold in the state of Florida. We are going to make sure that our laws are enforced and that no individual prosecutor puts themselves above the law.

It's simple. If you put yourself above the law, you are violating and neglecting your duty and you are displaying a lack of competence to be able to perform those duties. If you abandon the duties of your oath of office, you no longer have the right to hold that office.

The crime in places like San Francisco and Los Angeles is out of control. Police are unable to do their jobs, businesses are closing up shop, and violent criminals are walking free all because of the dereliction of duty by prosecutors who are funded by ideological activists. In Florida, we're not going to sit idly by and watch our state spiral into chaos. We're going to respect our law enforcement officers, we're going to protect our citizens, and we're going to enforce the law.

As your Governor, I will not stand for woke prosecutors, who are entrusted with enforcing the law, showing more deference and care for criminals than the victims of their crimes in the name of "social justice." Denying a victim their day in court is not justice. Allowing a criminal to walk free of consequences for their crimes is not justice. It is, in fact, the opposite of justice.

**_[[REJECT WOKE PROSECUTORS]](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=986334b1f3c4484a850ee00480884834&_e=I67K1kh6KxDydmQQEuQWAJhqv1SarvJHy_JreW_bNM4ssgdLsEtD190Vd6ADPLcX4y8YJQfT-F_pxbJm-qlYBZEMqrhArd5lEPzFnbQG-_ybR-yqJTFRMj7HVDS5WGHXpS9H-zpPptr4mM6NsgvUw3eS3cXxhSp8WtcHaIgc8PvEpj99Sm7JmusyuxRbwdufviIlP0m-POh1tYXVyPBuKx_cx_0V-F0v7n8SAlzmTfUeYn8HgtfPJFQnQzrGOpy_JbmVCHnAaUBX6yrOjuE_5CydvSezwUPHgKC1Z7eOcqUADMYXmIWDG4XDb76J6rPFQNFlvkd2sIDJqmTq4xXPvxNE7xIzLgJeOjG30YUOn1uVB_U7IHZL1AaoJgUjgNd_I02V0lTcAdwn-WA_BZbZHQ%3D%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=645171481de93327e26993ba67113f8689f06e8ca94ebda36bd320efd24e432ee79049f01519eca11f1dc046e8b3a44077fbaced8a682f9a")_**

Florida is a law-and-order state. I am not going to back down from that one inch. The radical Left is already attacking me for doing my job to ensure that the laws are enforced in our state. subject: The CHIPS Act & my opponent’s silence
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220811&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220811&amount=28]
Team,
Earlier this week, the bipartisan CHIPS Act was officially signed into law, legislation that means that American companies will manufacture more of the microchips that power everything from our cars to our cell phones.
These 14-cent microchips have been one of the main focuses of my work for the past two years, as global shortages have forced auto plants in my district to shut down on and off, leaving workers short-changed. Right now, 2% of the chips used in cars are made in America.
Which is why it’s surprising that my opponent hasn’t taken a clear stance on the CHIPS Act.
You can’t run for Congress without telling voters what you believe about the issues they care about. To mid-Michigan workers, that means microchips. My constituents tell me all the time about how much the chip shortage is hurting them. Cars can’t come off the lot, our military can’t build the planes and tanks it needs, and plants can’t keep the lights on. In all of this, Michigan’s workers are getting left in the lurch.
We’re at an inflection point in American history where we need to make a decision: are we going to make a change and invest in our ability to make chips at home and create jobs in Michigan, or are we going to allow ourselves to grow more and more dependent on Asia?
I’ve made it clear where I stand on the CHIPS Act, and after its passage I called on my opponent to do the same. So far, he’s been silent. If he wants the job, it’s time he tells the voter how he would have voted.

Dear Peter,

This fall, the newly extreme Supreme Court will hear Moore v. Harper, a case that carries serious consequences for the integrity of our elections, **[which is why we need experienced & proven leaders like Kevin Mullin in Congress with a record of standing up and protecting our democracy.](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=1935d8e47b&e=292fde286a)**

The same far-right court that just destroyed Roe v. Wade protections is now on the verge of fundamentally dismantling the federal government’s authority to stop anti-democratic, partisan gerrymandering.

Trump Republicans in the North Carolina legislature want their radical gerrymandered Congressional maps, that were previously struck down for violating voters’ rights, to be reinstated. This is a blatant attack on democracy.

**Kevin Mullin is no stranger to this fight, Peter. In the Assembly, he safeguarded our democracy and passed landmark laws to make it easier to vote and get dark money out of our elections. In Congress, you can bet that he won’t back down to Republican attempts to subvert our democracy and rig the system in their favor.

[But we need your help to make sure we win this race. Can you rush a donation of $25, $50, or $100 to help send a proven progressive to Washington to keep protecting our democracy?](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=f19137e42e&e=292fde286a)**

Team Mullin

name: Peter Welch
subject: A knife's edge Senate
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
If my opponent wins, he’ll be helping Mitch McConnell and the GOP bring our party to a standstill, and we can’t let that happen.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=794%2E61531%2EkX5sfl)
Hello,
Now that we’ve secured the Democratic nomination to represent Vermont in the U.S. Senate (thanks to your help!), we can now turn our full attention to this November’s election.
We officially know who our opponent is going to be too, and national Republicans—including Senate Minority Leader Mitch McConnell—have already begun working behind the scenes to flip this seat red in their efforts to regain the majority.
We currently have a knife’s edge Senate, split 50/50. McConnell and the GOP have been angling for a return to power since the second they lost it, and if he becomes the Majority Leader again, there’s no chance we advance the progressive agenda our country needs for its future. If my opponent wins this November, he’ll be helping McConnell and the rest of their party give more tax cuts to the rich at the expense of working families.
[**The Senate is up for grabs, and our race in Vermont is being closely monitored by Republicans all across the country. If you’re able, please make a $5 donation right away so we have what it takes to fight back and win.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3841?t=3&akid=794%2E61531%2EkX5sfl)
_If you’ve saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically:_

I firmly believe in working across the aisle and finding common ground with your political opponents, but that’s proven to be a challenge when Mitch McConnell’s in power.
I’ve watched good bill after good bill pass the House only to die in the Senate because McConnell’s been more concerned with maintaining his party’s control over our government than following the will of the American people.
Right now he’s using the filibuster to gum up our democracy, abusing his power even while he’s in the minority. He can’t be trusted to be Majority Leader again, and I believe this grassroots movement has the strength to ensure that doesn’t happen.
[**Election Day will be here before we know it, and I don’t want us leaving anything to chance. Can you help us meet (and hopefully surpass) our August fundraising goal with a $5**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3841?t=8&akid=794%2E61531%2EkX5sfl)[**contribution right away?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3841?t=9&akid=794%2E61531%2EkX5sfl)
Thanks again for all you do,
Peter

name: Nikki Haley
subject: You can do this!
body:
| | |
---
Friend,
---
_“You can do this.”_** ** That’s the voice in my head as I laced up my sneakers and forced myself outside.** ** Running isn’t always easy. Sometimes, it’s hot. Sometimes, I’m tired. Sometimes, my schedule is crazy. But I try to make time (when I can) to turn the world off and force myself to move. ** ** I’m always happy after I run. It clears my head and presses the reset button on my day. The music and the endorphins don’t hurt either! After a good run, I feel like I can accomplish anything.
---
[| | |
---|---|---](https://links.standforamericanow.com/u/click?_t=d85fab909a98477596691a746a1de4c5&_m=b1f43859b4654348bfd1a0c863c0af67&_e=SDgvevay9_nqorGrpx3twZAhb10E7tYeqpbhfXJAZ412tE2a7edIWO8KFpQ2x2cblDyOsSGYQn1mtt2mPs7OAY9YGGJxid90ET5Vb0zwxuZTHkgTtNaNDkiBUtWx8LQrbQuAqKKQnkNJyjVen6aTlCzsc8wCkcMjxLZ9g7dzpcpOjucWON0G6KfSQSko2BcxD3mQp7clBJm9yG3OK_YG-1UGaCDYjRfHOwYU_GK-2xddgO4EjLHTqzlpMYnR1wXUHlh4FZE5Tm2Dxl3tJlkM4A%3D%3D)
Running is a metaphor for life. There are good days and bad days. There are days when you feel like you can run 10 miles and days when a single mile feels like a chore. Putting in the effort consistently is half the battle. ** ** I’m sharing these stories because we are a team on a mission, and maybe you’ll find it helpful to know how I deal with the ups and downs of campaign life. We’ve endorsed a lot of candidates this cycle, many of whom I’ve gotten to know really well. I take their races personally. I take our mission personally. Running helps me refuel when I’m down; it helps me recommit to the task in front of us. It inspires me to work harder. ** ** If you’re a runner then you know what I’m talking about. And if you’re not — that’s okay. I never thought of myself as a runner either! But I encourage you to find something in your life that makes you feel alive and helps you clear out the mental clutter. ** ** Because the coming battle over the next three months will be brutal. We have to pull together and gird ourselves for the deluge of attacks. We have to find the motivational music and blast it. We have to fight like we’ve never fought before. ** ** Thank you for joining me on this journey. We are so much stronger together, and that is my number one motivation of all. ** ** My very best,
---
---
Nikki

name: Giffords.org
subject: M&P 15 (before there was an AR-15)
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Prior to 1998, guns like the AR-15 were a pariah.
#

Friends -
In 1995, I made the decision to get into the gun industry. And for the first several years of my career, tactical gear was not allowed in the largest trade shows.
Further, companies like Ruger even included their founding motto on all advertising: “Arms Maker for Responsible Citizens.”
Prior to 1998, guns like the AR-15 were a pariah.
But they represented an untapped market, the NRA and NSSF needed new political symbols and profit, so companies like Smith and Wesson made the decision to get into the AR-15 business.
A few years later, the M&P 15 (M&P as in Military and Police) became the best selling rifle in America.
Eventually, young male gun customers in places like Parkland, Florida, Highland Park, Illinois and more decided to use an M&P 15 to carry out horrific crimes that we know claimed the lives of 17 people at a high school and seven parade attendees, respectively.
In 2008, Ruger made the decision to remove the responsible citizen motto from most of its public advertising.
I was inside the industry as new companies like Daniel Defense built businesses by advertising AR-15s with slogans encouraging young men to “Use what the special forces guys use.”
The industry leaders who spoke out against this new trajectory were attacked and marginalized.
That continues to this day.
Back to Daniel Defense.
When they tweeted a picture of a toddler, blessed by a Proverbs verse, while cradling an AR-15 on the same day as the Uvalde shooter was killing kids with one of their rifles, there was no criticism from industry leadership.
But there was a prestigious reward.
The same NSSF Board of Governors rewarded Marty Daniel, of Daniel Defense, with a coveted seat on their Board of Governors.
Any rational person can see the direct lines from toxic gun manufacturer marketing to troubled young men who kill people in places like Buffalo, El Paso, and Uvalde.
Anyone can see the direct lines to our nation’s most dangerous domestic terror organizations.
And I will never stop trying to warn people that there is much more of this marketing on the way.
No one from the gun industry is going to stop it — and it’s likely to get worse.
The ones who have the power to stop this are our elected officials.
They are the ones who have to decide what our nation will do about all of this.
Giffords will never stop fighting until dangerous assault weapons are regulated once again by law, and I am proud to be a part of their team in that fight.
All my best,
Ryan Busse
Giffords Senior Advisor
* * *

Giffords is leading the fight to pass an Assault Weapons Ban in Congress, but we cannot do it without your support. We’ve made such progress over the past decade thanks to support from people like you, but we can’t stop now. We’ll put your donation right to work in our fight to pass an Assault Weapons Ban.
**[CONTRIBUTE NOW](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-august22.eGgdz1&refcode=em220811-1-30&t=1&akid=2309%2E3935704%2Euty80M)**

I made a special link for you to chip in here: [**dpwillis67@gmail.com**](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=76b8715d475249aca8dd298b726cf134&_e=EztVSrZDyfahrMlM4Fn3-wfd-_MGgc6B52gUFS3zvX0rsFbKfUq00-Ve8ZH4LVgczi2slHWrNOezaKJBl8BXgkQf_wp5llcwvjhfdE42JrTptzZnABjECC1Ahl2poLRAQQBdyVlr14mu7lH78PZOkCshdVUmAMgyx_JwjKpFcdGnQQZ625rveaWOP_t2HxGZ1qSl2iobVRwVLQ9XgQovHZ6QV5SwvrPJ651AVFMTAsxZ2lrbmskI9aB1BV638O_cov56AmZJxk4lWdK-Oa7XTw6X1yDd1_Iw3lye4TIKjuOKXolZJdepVQURLCL0Gup0TQwNr-fhTXwQXLd1XXZhzCTxcUScaVZrnZG8SJbIlvBCZ2-wQEwjEc-JLsyo6NhJMclthjB2CdpSYhN1S6DCdSPf-uCwsXWF3LuBo9ySlSPGPOOk04PFv_L5k-QVa9ryWPfINuhQ-2dcljfgS9RFU-KoZMtc5fLh6gEcVdGKDYm5QJHy_Q84O0uL2BP6XCPsrA5_aPYPZ7aC9sw28Ue-M1O11cTP6An4ciCLNG2HSRo%3D)

I would be honored if you could show your support and [**donate to my campaign.**](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=76b8715d475249aca8dd298b726cf134&_e=EztVSrZDyfahrMlM4Fn3-wfd-_MGgc6B52gUFS3zvX0rsFbKfUq00-Ve8ZH4LVgczi2slHWrNOezaKJBl8BXgkQf_wp5llcwvjhfdE42JrTptzZnABjECC1Ahl2poLRAQQBdyVlr14mu7lH78PZOkCshdVUmAMgyx_JwjKpFcdGnQQZ625rveaWOP_t2HxGZ1qSl2iobVRwVLQ9XgQovHZ6QV5SwvrPJ651AVFMTAsxZ2lrbmskI9aB1BV638O_cov56AmZJxk4lWdK-Oa7XTw6X1yDd1_Iw3lye4TIKjuOKXolZJdepVQURLCL0Gup0TQwNr-fhTXwQXLd1XXZhzNTEFe_2XfULv24q9ROFm0cx-7sy-6XXibe_Z64pUtqzI0oJUv6XI5Fm1ALDX9rqAOLQ0EhMlmRoxVlzdu84fcFnsKoBVN0lOLKKufIbH-xAWqdNtISnpwrnt2dsJM2OPQniYuCHhxJT9Rtsa-fxyj3esL787EM1VroQnRa5Ncu-E7SR3OwcYOlmc_ZQe00EvmrN7l7vYk8UmCn4SyOISKE%3D)

# Saturday | The Pit | Livestream
---
|
---
| This Saturday, August 13th, 2022, Right Side Broadcasting Network will be livestreaming our event, called **The Pit** , beginning at noon eastern.
What is The Pit? The name was taken from the scripture in Psalms 94:12-15
_Blessed is the one you discipline, Lord, the one you teach from your law; you grant them relief from days of trouble, till a pit is dug. For the Lord will not reject his people; he will never forsake his inheritance. Judgment will again be founded on righteousness, and all the upright in heart will follow it._
Attendees include 150+ social media influencers, journalists, researchers, law enforcement, and leading activists. The event will be live-streamed on **[Right Side Broadcasting Network (RSBN)](https://truethevote.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d9ab56570d4ecf7b7df9d4c25&id=4073788f45&e=ad8cba7e98)**.
[](https://truethevote.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d9ab56570d4ecf7b7df9d4c25&id=49b525a1a8&e=ad8cba7e98)
The Pit will be unlike any event we've ever hosted. We will share new information, provide solutions, calls to action, and educate about the real enemy we face \- the globalist communist movement. They are bringing massive funding, espionage, and disinformation campaigns on both the right and the left.

Our broad goal is to bring a variety of people with critical skill sets together to uphold lawful elections and fight back against the subversion of the left and complacency of the right. There's no more time to waste.

If you are inclined to support our efforts, **[we need resources now more than ever](https://truethevote.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d9ab56570d4ecf7b7df9d4c25&id=173abac952&e=ad8cba7e98)**. We are providing grants to sheriffs, supporting a citizen led fusion center, and leading as the tip of the spear for honest American elections.

I believe everything we’ve been through has been to prepare for what is coming next. It will be a battle, but if we work together, we can win.

Ever onward-
Catherine
